Name: Fire Manipulation
Short Description: Ever wanted to start a fire? With this you can! You gain the ability to generate and control completely normal fire.

Will only have sex with those who have her trust and is a switch in bed. One of her idle wishes is to have a penis, simply to see how it feels.

Name: The Ball Gag of Truth
Short Description: So long as the ball gag is being properly worn, the wearer must tell the truth, the whole truth, and indicate whether or not they are unsure of a piece of information. Works 100% of the time, guaranteed. No refunds.

Name: Hyper Fetation
Short Description: Allows you to get pregnant even while currently pregnant. Children after the first will grow faster to catch up to the first child. While this ensures you will carry to term and give birth without complication regardless of the number of pregnancies, it does not ensure comfort.

Name: The Butt Plug of Submission
Short Description: When inserted into someone's ass, will render them into an extremely suggestible state where they will follow all of your orders. They may be instructed to act normally, but will drop everything to carry out your orders once given unless otherwise instructed. The buttplug will expand or contract for the perfect fit, is self lubricating, and cannot be removed accidentally. Though it can be removed by anyone, not only the person who placed it.

Name: Anya Forger
Short Description: A (self-claimed) 10 year old female child. She is heavily interested in spies and spying and is psychic- able to read the minds of people around her.

Name: MILF Beam
Short Description: A beam which, upon hitting a target, turns them into a MILF. By default turns them into a MILF version of themselves, but can be directed to change into a specific look. Does not include clothes upon transforming, but does prevent injury from current clothing being destroyed as a result of the transformation.

Name: Gender Bending Beam
Short Description: A beam that turns the target into the opposite gender. Permanent unless the beam is used again. By default they look exactly as if they were born that way and grew to their current age under the exact same circumstances. With practice the user can specify physical traits, such as larger boobs, or general traits, such as not suffering from a lack of nutrients while growing, which will be applied to the resultant transformation. Changes current clothing to what the affected would be wearing at the moment they were struck had they grown up as the gender they were turned into.

Name: SOUND EFFECTS
Short Description: Every action you take is now accompanied by a sound effect! This will not reveal your location to anyone unaware of it, but people aware of you can also hear the effects.

Name: God Hand
Short Description: You have been granted twelve lives. This doesn't make you any more naturally resistant to damage, but once killed by something you gain significantly increased resistance against that same thing. You regenerate a life a week, and the resistance is removed upon gaining that life back.

Name: Lewd Sealing
Short Description: You have an innate understanding of creating magical tattoos for lewd purposes and a large beginners kit to get you started. Lust crests, fertility modifying tattoos, kink writing, moral degredation scribbling, and even turning others into mind controlled slaves are all possible. As well as quite a bit more. With significant effort, you can learn how to make non-lewd effects, but you have no natural talent with those from this roll.

Name: Mon Pass
Short Description: Monster fucker, are we? Nobody will find it odd if you fuck monsters, even if such a thing would normally raise concerns. This does not ensure any given moster would be willing to fuck you, nor does it apply in the case that the monster is genuinely incapable of consent. Also doesn't provide any protection when it comes to the necessary requirements for actually having sex with the monster in question. Better get a Potion of Fire Immunity before fucking that Flame Atronach.

Name: A Condom
Short Description: A singular, unopened condom. It will someone perfectly fit whoever opens it.

Name: Off Screen Moment of Awesome
Short Description: So long as the world isn't looking, it can't say no. You will win any fight... as long as something more important is going on at the same time. Fighting a drunk in an alleyway? An important woman meeting a guy might be enough to assure victory. Facing an army in a final grand stand? If the Protagonist isn't getting his home burned down at the same time, you're going to get mulched.

Name: Silver Crystal
Short Description: The crystal of hope and light, capable of reviving an entire world from death, purifying evil, and much more.

Name: A Single Super Chaos Emerald
Short Description: The super version of a Chaos Emerald. Far stronger than the smaller ones. Get all 7 and 7 Chaos Emeralds to unlock a Hyper form.

Name: Zilla Sr.
Short Description: The so-called Godzilla that attacked New York in 1998. Resistant to conventional weapons, vulnerable to six missiles to the throat. Can lay eggs via parthenogenesis.

Name: Hyper Muteki Gashat
Short Description: A totally normal game item. Nominally no use, but grants immense power when combined with the Gamer Driver. Combine with the ??? Gashat for a special new form.

Name: Book of Unconventional and Horny Spells
Short Description: A leatherbound tome that contains horny and depraved spells (and dumb) spells within, such as "Fushigi", "FAT TITS", Dick In Your Mouth, Glitter Blaster, Lube Sprinkler, Paper Pigeons, etc. Cast by shouting "I CAST" and the name of the spell.

Name: Zofa Soldiers
Short Description: A squad of 5 Zofa Soldiers clad in tight latex, with masks and belts. Decent enough cannon fodder, their real use is to infect and convert other people into more Zofa Soldiers (the horny way).

Name: Psycho
Short Description: A highly addictive combat drug meant to suppress pain, induce a blood rage, enhance reflexes, increase metabolism, and enhance concentration. 8 doses in one bandoleer. Try not to make a habit of it.

Name: Bondage of Enduring
Short Description: A set of silk bondage ropes that, when tied and worn instead of clothes, enhances durability and stamina regeneration, and converts pain into pleasure.

Name: One Thousand Bottles of Baby Oil
Short Description: One thousand bottles of unbranded baby oil. Yes. Like that guy. You know the guy.

Name: Kaguya Houraisan Fumo
Short Description: A fumo of a certain Lunar Princess. It bears the concept of eternity, which means it cannot ever be destroyed and will stay like that forever.

Name: Beginner Mechanics
Short Description: Skill equivalent to a mechanic's apprentice, you can now fix basic appliances and even a car with the right tools. Improves faster with the right teachers.

Name: Beginner Biology
Short Description: The skill of a biology major, you have a decent knowledge of biology, bodies, organs, and biological interactions.

Name: Beginner Taming
Short Description: The skill of a decent animal tamer, you can tame non-mundane creatures with trial and error, though it's not easy.

Name: Beginner Driving
Short Description: You can drive most vehicles competently, not particularly well, but decently enough.

Name: Clowning Around
Short Description: The skill of telling jokes, entertaining kids, making balloon animals, fitting in tiny cars, putting on greasepaint, and other things. You are, in effect, a professional clown.

Name: Blind Eye
Short Description: You disappear into crowds- if you shouldn't stand out, you won't.

Name: Natural Swimmer
Short Description: You are a natural born swimmer. Your resistance to and skill with water/sea based effects is increased.

Name: Heat Palm
Short Description: Allows you to heat only your palms to red-hot levels, just shy of 1000 degrees Celsius

Name: Spray Water
Short Description: Spray water from your hands with roughly the same force as a garden hose or a shower head. Runs on stamina.

Name: Flash
Short Description: Emit blinding light from your hands. Can be dialed up or down for utility. Doesn't work well outside of close range.

Name: Stick
Short Description: You can stick to things like you've been superglued on. Not quite as good as Spider-Man.

Name: Ripen
Short Description: Allows you to ripen and mature organic objects via touch. Doesn't work if the object resists.

Name: Sprout
Short Description: Communicate with and control plants at a low level, tel them to grow faster, imbue them with energy for higher growth rates, even slightly change their shape.

Name: Tactical Vision
Short Description: Swap between thermal, infrared, and night vision at will without imparing normal sight.

Name: Camera Mark
Short Description: Place glowing red runes on any stable physical surface. Each rune acts like a 360 degree camera within your mind, viewable at any time. Maximum rune coverage based on energy levels, start with 5.

Name: Lion
Short Description: A very smart and powerful majestic lion companion. Default female. Large enough to ride.

Name: Goblin
Short Description: A child sized humanoid. Vicious and cruel by nature, good with small arms and basic tactics. Smarter than the average goblin, capable of breeding with any humanoid species. Default female.

Name: Herbie, the Love Bug
Short Description: A sentient, self driving 1963 VW Beetle with unusually high performance metrics. Can self repair slowly when unsummoned.

Name: Remy the Rat
Short Description: An unusually smart, snarky rat who is very good at cooking, and also can control twinks by pulling their hair.

Name: Catgirlifying Tail
Short Description: A large cat tail buttplug. When worn will gradually turn the user into a catgirl, finishing after a collective twelve (12) hours. This confers a minor bonus to speed, flexibility, and strength. Please wash before re-use.

Name: Liti-gator
Short Description: An alligator that is, somehow, a master of litigation and the skills of an attorney. Very well read in your local world's laws, might have some trouble actually representing you.

Name: Cleansing Stone
Short Description: A one foot diameter stone sphere that cleans and removes filth from garments and bodies on touch. Best mount it somewhere safe.

Name: It's A Mad World
Short Description: Everything gets a bit more... metaphorical. You've somehow slipped right into Wonderland, a place where metaphor is fact, dimensions are a suggestion, and we're all mad. Yes, including you.

Name: Tank
Short Description: A tank from an actual real world military. Effectively infinite fuel and shells within, but otherwise just a tank. You get to choose which tank it is.

Name: ColorS
Short Description: A common magical item used to change the color of one's worn outfit by sliding a finger over the mirror on the front surface. Takes the form of a small pink book with an intricate cover.

Name: An Endless Supply of Sunglasses
Short Description: Whenever you desire you may pull a pair of sunglasses from whatever containter is available. They will be properly sized and act in all ways as completely normal sunglasses

Name: Scooby Snax
Short Description: A box of weirdly tasty dog treats. Familiars and familiar candidates seem to like them. Consumable by just about anything. Box contains a lifetime supply, and will pour largely indefinitely.

Name: Unspoken Plan Guarantee
Short Description: The less people that know a plan of yours, the more likely it is to work.

Name: Ghost Blade
Short Description: A cursed dagger carried by the spirits of New Londo. Allows you to wound spiritual beings (does not do soul damage to living beings).

Name: Veil of Invisibility
Short Description: A cloak that turns the user invisible only when not wearing clothing other than the veil.

Name: Father Garcia's Trenchcoat
Short Description: A stylish black trench coat worn by Father Garcia. Durable, wards off curses and negative energy.

Name: Big Hat Logan's Big Hat
Short Description: Big Hat Logan's titular Big Hat. Makes it easier to learn and study magic while wearing it.

Name: Fog Walls
Short Description: When you approach a difficult or important confrontation, you will see a fog wall barring the entrance. Only by being willing to face what is inside will you enter, and anything within it will not react to what you do while outside unless an attack strikes them. They are not bound to stay within the wall, and it will move with them if they enter another room.

Name: Vergil's Meme Chair
Short Description: A shitty plastic chair that increases your motivation when sitting in it. Might survive a hurricane.

Name: Beginner Massage
Short Description: The skill of an apprentice masseuse, good at working out knots and relieving pressure for a normal human.

Name: Makeup Application
Short Description: You have a skill for applying makeup and enhancing beauty with topical products.

Name: Beginner Discipline
Short Description: You can endure slight hardship, eat stuff you don't like, study when you don't want to, but otherwise your discipline is still normal human levels.

Name: Beginner Communication
Short Description: You can communicate your ideas, meanings, and thoughts better than the average person, but not that much.

Name: Sartorial Savant
Short Description: Your clothes are always clean and tidy, and your small damages mend themselves over time.

Name: Kanmusu'd
Short Description: Whoops, you're a shipgirl now! Sorry if that causes any dysphoria. Pick a ship, most any ship! Anything from after roughly the second world war, or equivalent tech level, is out. You are now as durable as that ship, have the same amount of space inside of you, can move on water as fast as that ship, and have the same arnaments as that ship.  Including Radar, should that ship have it. Also a snazzy outfit bsaed on the ship you can call at will. Objects may be placed into you hold regardless of size, so long as they would fit within to storage space within yourself. You systems are run by 'Fairies', tiny girls dressed according to your ship's ranking who assist in your running and repair you. Also gain access to spooky magic, stronger the older your ship is. Unfortunately, now you also require the same level of fuel- you are restocked for 24hrs every 24hs, but combat burns your reserves faster.

Name: Kanmusu'd Abyssal Edition!
Short Description: Whoops, you're an abyssal shipgirl now! Sorry if that causes any dysphoria. Pick a ship, most any ship! Anything from after roughly the second world war, or equivalent tech level, is out. You are now as durable as that ship, have the same amount of space inside of you, can move on water as fast as that ship, and have the same arnaments as that ship.  Including Radar, should that ship have it. Your skin is now pale white, and you can summon a black outfit themed after a sea creature. Objects may be placed into you hold regardless of size, so long as they would fit within to storage space within yourself. You systems are run by 'Fairies', tiny girls dressed according to your ship's ranking who assist in your running and repair you. You are consumed by grudges and are significantly more likely to form them and to percieve things as attacks against you. Also get powerful spooky magic, better the older your ship is. Unfortunately, now you also require the same level of fuel- you are restocked for 24hrs every 24hs, but combat burns your reserves faster.

Name: Were-something
Short Description: Pick a mammal. You now uncontrollably turn into a humanoid version of that animal upon the light of the full moon. You're in control of yourself, but the process in incredibly painful at first. With time and practice you may be able to partly or fully transform without the full moon and lower the pain, but the moon will always transform you. You're also incredibly weak to silver, and even more sensitive to inherited silver- a touch from a weapon of that likely means death. Otherwise, you're stronger, faster, and heal quicker.

Name: Official Certificate of Knighthood
Short Description: Congrats, you're a knight! You get a suit of armor, some fancy heraldry, a melee weapon of choice, and the acknowledgement of any authority that cares about knights.

Name: Pornographic Body
Short Description: You've got a body fit for porn. If you're male, you're very tall, with massive muslces, and a massive dick. If you're female, you're still tall, with massive tits and a massive ass. Either way, your makeup is fantastic and presentation immaculate no matter what. Maintaining this requires no effort and you suffer no complications from being this way.

Name: Too Cool for Two
Short Description: You're way too cool. Anything you could do with two hands you can do with one hand in your pocket.

Name: Law of Games
Short Description: Physical conflict is forbidden. All wagers, violence, and other things must be settled by a game agreed upon by both parties, knowing all the rules. This is enforced by the world itself and cannot be dodged through any non-S rank divine or demonic effect. Though nothing says a game must keep playing by those rules...

Name: The Oldest Profession
Short Description: Sex is viewed significantly more transactionally now. Offering sex for money, discounts, to satisfy a debt, or to avoid being harmed or killed is expected and normal. It doesn't make anyone more likely to accept, but you can certainly offer.

Name: Big Bag o Seeds
Short Description: A big bag of various seeds ready for planting. Particularly rare plants won't be included, but aside from that every plant on Earth is represented. It's recommended not to plant kudzu or bamboo.

Name: Iron Tree
Short Description: A planter pot of a small iron tree as well as a few seeds and a book on proper planting and caring techniques. The tree will grow leaves of iron year round, equivalent to five bars of high quality iron each month.

Name: Slime Ranch
Short Description: Congrats on inheriting a ranch on the Far Far Range! Yes, even if you had no living relatives. Don't question it. You may teleport to the ranch at will. The ranch consists of a small home attached to a large portion of the Far Far Range. The place may be upgraded with money, including unlocking more pens and various helpful equipment. Here you may capture and feed slimes in order to get plorts, which can be traded at the on site marketplace. Plorts follow normal market principles, so selling a lot of one type lowers the price and rare plorts are more expensive. Money obtained here is converted at a rougly 1 to 1 ratio to the currency of your home world.

Name: Perfumed
Short Description: You smell nice, and always smell what the person smelling you likes.

Name: Edible Body Fluids
Short Description: Your sweat, saliva, blood, cum, etc are healthy, nutritionally and calorically dense, and taste good. Anyone could survive off of them, sadly not you though.

Name: Ambidextrous
Short Description: Technically it's "Omnidextrous". You have equal dexterity with all your limbs, not just your hands. Applies to non-standard limbs as well.

Name: Lactation
Short Description: You lactate now! Hope that's not dysphoric for you. Your milk quality scales with physical stats and gains unique properties based on your gained tickets.

Name: Literary Devouring
Short Description: You can literally eat books and physical texts to absorb their knowledge with perfect recall. Some books might fight back.

Name: Tinder
Short Description: Allows you to create and control weak flames from the strength of matches up to bonfires.

Name: Aura Farming
Short Description: You instinctively know the best places and methods to farm aura in whatever way you find most appealing. Want to seem cool? You know just the spot to stand to make your cape flow dramatically in the wind. Want to seem intimidating? That alleyway at this specific time has just the right shadow to cover your face but not your body.

Name: Shadow Cloak
Short Description: Cloak yourself in shadows to make yourself harder to perceive and muffle all sounds you make.

Name: Tail
Short Description: You can grow a tail now! Choose its appearance to your liking. It's quite strong and dexterous too.

Name: Lesser Despair Aura
Short Description: Emit an aura of despair that makes people uneasy and induces fear in weaker targets.

Name: Perfect Measurement
Short Description: You know the exact measurements and dimensions of any object just by looking at it.

Name: First Aid
Short Description: You can expend energy via touch to provide basic first aid- healing scrapes and bruises, minor cuts, etc etc. Dependent on the strength difference between you and your target.

Name: Fight Mode
Short Description: Floods your brain with all of those good shit fight chemicals- adrenaline, cortisol, endorphins, etc. No consequences for overdosing on them either.

Name: A Bra that Fits
Short Description: A bra that will always fit you. Doesn't matter how large or flat you are- it fits. Also properly braces you and comes in whatever color and pattern you want! If destroyed, you get a new one in 24hrs. You may change the look of it in the same time frame.

Name: Tiger
Short Description: One singular female tiger companion, stronger and smarter than normal. Large enough to ride.

Name: Chauffeur
Short Description: Summons a very luxurious limousine driven by a construct. Will take you anywhere that it can successfully drive to. Vanishes after breaking line of sight. If destroyed, returns after 24 hours.

Name: Tentacle Cleaner
Short Description: A slimy ball of tentacles that can clean literally anything with no residue or smell remaining. Cannot fight. Not intended for bedroom use.

Name: Isabelle
Short Description: An anthropomorphic cute little Shih Tzu who's really good at being a secretary and manager. Can handle an entire town if necessary. No combat abilities (Get a duplicate for her Smash moveset).

Name: EVE
Short Description: A vaguely iphone-aesthetic mass produced egg shaped search probe designed for finding plantlife. High speed hovering and flight, as well as a built in energy rifle.

Name: Polygamous Castration Fist
Short Description: Obtain an ancient scroll which gives instructions on how to learn and utilize the Polygamous Castration Fist, a martial arts style which emphasizes nut shots, kicks, and single strike power. You have significantly increased ability to learn this style, becoming a master with a few days of dedicated training. Especially effective against unfaithful partners.

Name: Interro-gator
Short Description: An alligator who happens to be a master of interrogation, questioning, and interviewing. Unfortunately well versed in less ethical forms of questioning as well.

Name: Kaneda's Bike
Short Description: Kaneda's sick-ass bike from AKIRA. Super fast, super stylish, super iconic. And it does the Slide.

Name: Charismatic Sunglasses
Short Description: A pair of really cool sunglasses that increase charisma. You decide their appearance.

Name: Single Use Weapon Voucher
Short Description: Tear this ticket to receive any one mundane real world (man portable) weapon, fully loaded. Arrives in your hand instantly.

Name: Blessed Silver Spoon
Short Description: A silver spoon blessed to deal extra damage to vampires, ghouls, werewolves, and other similar supernatural beings. Still useful as a spoon.

Name: Beginner Cooking
Short Description: You can cook most basic meals at an acceptable level, but you aren't a chef yet. You learn cooking faster with the right teachers.

Name: Great Cardio
Short Description: You have great cardio for a normal human, includes increased stamina and stamina regen. Solid lung capacity and heart.

Name: Charming Smile
Short Description: Your smile is more charming and comforting to others. Also, more attractive to your preferred gender.

Name: Golden Shot
Short Description: If you inseminate anyone with a vagina, they WILL get pregnant, even if they were previously unable to get pregnant. Also includes a customizable penis. Can be rerolled for free.

Name: Physique of the Undead
Short Description: Allows your body to go beyond Death. In exchange for looking incredibly crusty if and when you die, you gain increased strength, and the ability to self modify through Souls. Also allows you to place down a Coiled Sword to create a Bonfire once a week.

Name: Great Ass!
Short Description: You have a really nice ass. Round, soft, big, great at cushioning. Nice and slappable.

Name: Firestarter
Short Description: You gain resistance to and extra efficiency in fire and heat based effects and abilities.

Name: Megaphone
Short Description: Amplify all sounds you make to the point that it stuns and deafens opponents.

Name: Taser
Short Description: Create and channel electricity through your body, strong enough to stun or seriously injure an opponent.

Name: Rock Throw
Short Description: Create and launch fist sized rocks and stones as hard as you could regularly throw one. Takes stamina.

Name: Claws
Short Description: You can grow sharp, durable claws on your fingertips, strong enough to go through stone.

Name: Rusting
Short Description: Allows you to make metals rust via touch. Doesn't work on metals that can't rust.

Name: Airskating
Short Description: You can now hover 1cm off the ground and air-skate with nearly zero friction. Like a certain edgy hedgehog.

Name: Summon Small Item
Short Description: Mark up to 10 items weighing a tenth of your lifting capacity. You can now summon them at will, and send them back to where they were instantly.

Name: Lube Emission
Short Description: You can dispense safe, water-based lubricant from any point on your body, from a tiny trickle like sweat to shooting like a garden hose.

Name: Featherlight Step
Short Description: Cover your body in a light aura that decreases the pressure and weight you put on an object to nearly nothing. You could walk on cobwebs or water. Falls hurt, but deal no serious damage. Does not work for damaging strikes or effects.

Name: Project Image
Short Description: Project 2d planes that can show images or videos as you can remember or imagine. The planes are roughly stationary where projected unless physically moved, and have the rough properties of 1cm thick tempered glass.

Name: Tinker Bell
Short Description: The spunkiest little fairy from Neverland. Small and delicate, but provides fairy dust to allow others to fly with her.

Name: Navi-gator
Short Description: An alligator that just happens to be really good at navigation. If given a map and compass, it can lead you just about anywhere.

Name: Patrasche
Short Description: A sort of raptor-looking Earth Dragon, extremely loyal and about as strong as a horse, if not more. Has Divine Protection of Wind Evasion, allowing her to ignore wind resistance while running.

Name: Arvak
Short Description: A badass skeleton horse. Strong and has infinite stamina, respawns when killed after 10 seconds.

Name: Nipple Rings of Distraction
Short Description: A pair of gold nipple rings. They will attach painlessly to whoever puts them on and can only removed by the same hand. When worn and exposed, causes a mild hypnotic effect that makes people want to stare at them. The effect is continuous and will reapply immediately if given the chance. It takes a moderate effort of will to break the effect and look away before being ensnared again.

Name: 1993 Shotgun
Short Description: A large, 4 gauge shotgun with IDKFA scratched into the side. Comes loaded with 10 shells, restocks once a day.

Name: UAC Space Marine Armor
Short Description: Green high tech torso armor with dark green pants, military boots, a full face helmet, combat gloves, and hip pouches. Get a duplicate for the more protective blue variant.

Name: UAC EMG Sidearm
Short Description: A sidearm used by UAC soldiers. It fires hardening plasma gel at high velocity, resembling a chargeable energy beam. It has effectively infinite ammo.

Name: Doomguy's Chainsaw
Short Description: A heavy duty yellow chainsaw with "Painsaw" written on the side. Comes with a full tank of gas. Kills with it cause ammo of all necessary types to spew from the corpse.

Name: Super Shotgun
Short Description: An ornate sawn off double barreled shotgun with a "meathook" grappling attachment on the bottom. Get a duplicate to upgrade it for higher fire and reload rate plus engulfing grappled opponents with fire. Comes with 20 shells.

Name: BFG 9000
Short Description: BIG. FUCKING. GUN. Gigantic sci fi gun that fires massive orbs of green plasma that fry anything within proximity with electrical arcs and detonate on impact. Very badass. Comes with enough charge for 3 shots.

Name: One pre-owned copy of AvP
Short Description: A copy of the Aliens vs Predator video game with a save file containing five minutes of playtime on the Marine campaign.

Name: Lipples
Short Description: Allows you to turn your nipples into a pair of luscious lips with connected mouths. You can eat, breathe, even speak through them with practice. Still as sensitive as your actual nipples, if not more. Works best with fat titties.

Name: The Manyuu Scroll
Short Description: A scroll of secrets, techniques, and abilities to increase the size and quality of a woman's breasts. Included is the Manyuu clan's secret technique: Breast Flow, allowing the transfer of breast size and energy between the user and other women, willing or not.

Name: To Serve Man
Short Description: A cookbook all about preparing and cooking human flesh

Name: All Fiction
Short Description: Kumagawa's Minus, allowing you to deny reality and making things into "nothing". If you perceive its existence, you can make it not exist, from objects to concepts. Fails against extremely strong emotions and attachments. Good luck fighting someone with Spiral Energy, dipshit.

Name: Triple Baka!
Short Description: The Triple Baka Trio! Hatsune Miku, Kasane Teto, Akita Neru! They dance, they sing, they each have their own powers! They're basically the idol version of the Powerpuff girls, each with their own assorted set of powers. They mostly only use them when it's funny, though.

Name: Shin Godzilla
Short Description: An amphibious, radioactive monster. Starts "small" and aquatic, and rapidly mutates into a bipedal terrestrial form roughly 100 meters tall. Genuinely, why would you want this familiar.

Name: Uncle Ruckus
Short Description: Uncle Ruckus, the most anti-black black man in existence. Apparently knows how to do an exorcism, if you find that useful.

Name: Call in the EDF!
Short Description: Rip the ticket to summon the EDF to defend a location for up to 1 week, with all of their equipment and industrial might.

Name: Haru Urara
Short Description: The sweetest, pinkest umamusume you've ever met. She's not good at a lot, and she's a bit simpleminded, but she always does her best with a great big smile!

Name: One Singular Regular Brick
Short Description: Literally just a regular brick, could have literally been taken from a construction site.

Name: Agnes Tachyon
Short Description: The aura farming, insane, autistic, labcoat wearing funny horse lady. Her body is fragile, but her mind is sharp, and she wishes to see the peak of umamusume speed.

Name: 30 Silver Pieces
Short Description: 30 pieces of bloodstained silver. Surely this has no deeper meaning. Might cause conflict.

Name: Tech Tree: Murder Drones
Short Description: You have the knowledge and capability to build anything from the series Murder Drones- worker drones, disassembly drones, railguns, sentinels, pill babies, etc. You might need some eldritch help for some of them.

Name: Fist of the Nose Hair
Short Description: Complete control over one's nose hairs, along with the skill to use them in combat. Also, a lot of cutaway gags and comedy bits.

Name: Huntsman
Short Description: An Australian-made wooden recurve bow with black tape and a quiver full of arrows. Each arrow occasionally does some wack-ass bullshit and hits someone in a critical spot despite it making no sense.

Name: Arcanum: Cookie Run
Short Description: Heres a chef's toque and an apron. You are now capable of magical baking, giving life to the cookies you create. Stronger cookies take more effort and study to make, but there is very little you cannot eventually bake a cookie to do. While any power is possible, it's much easier to bake cookies that use powers you've obtained from the gacha. Though the power the cookie has will be significantly lower. The cookies you bake are intelligent, sapient, and loyal to you as their baker. They'll attempt to assist in any way they can, and especially in ways you ask them.

Name: The armor of DOOM!bones (TM)
Short Description: Powered armor. It is encrusted with Warpstone and menaces with an integrated warpfire thrower. Powered by Verminlords (daemons). Satisfaction not guaranteed, no refunds.

Name: Maria Constitution
Short Description: Connect to a periodic element. Gain the ability to manipulate that element on the periodic table to an extremely fine degree. Make weapons, manipulate electrical signals, so on and so forth. These powers are fueled by Soma, a substance generated by Maria from their breasts. Gain a single ticket to turn someone else into a Maria, as per 'Maria Constitution'. This ticket cannot be used on yourself, but you can still become a Maria by rolling it on the gacha. You will not get the extra ticket from that roll in that case.

Name: Qwaser Alchemy
Short Description: Connect to an element. No, not that element, the periodic type. Gain the ability to manipulate a single element on the periodic table to an extremely fine degree. Including forming weapons out of the carbon in the environment, using gold filament to manipulate minds through altering electrical signals, and using the iron in blood to make weapons. These powers are fueled by Soma, a substance generated by Maria from their breasts. Gain a single ticket to turn someone else into a Maria, as per 'Maria Constitution'. This ticket cannot be used on yourself, but you can still become a Maria by rolling it on the gacha. You will not get the extra ticket from that roll in that case.

Name: Legion Arms
Short Description: A prosthetic arm which is highly modifiable. Starts with only being able to Punch Real Hard, but can be altered to shoot grappling hooks, fire shotgun shells, lay landmines, spray fire, and various other effects. You have the option to immediately attach it with no problems to whichever arm you wish or simply gain the prosthetic to attach later. So long as it is being attached by someone who knows what they're doing, there will be no complications or rejection reaction.

Name: Tech Tree: Bionicle
Short Description: It all starts with Protodermis. A substance you can now make. From that you are capable of intuiting how to build anything from the Bionicle series- masks, disks, Toa, Rahi, Makuta, and more. Larger or more powerful builds require larger amounts of resources.

Name: Kanohi - Ignika (Mask of Life)
Short Description: The legendary Mask of Life. Grants a number of life based powers, including, but not limited to, evolving and devolving creatures, healing, absord life energy, fire life energy in a blast of power, and communicating telepathically. Also has the ability to make itself a body. Generally rather naive and sheltered, but courageous to the point recklessness.

Name: Arlecchino, King of Riddles
Short Description: One of the first puppets to awaken his ego and achieve full personhood. Also a bloodthirsty serial killer who fancies himself an artist. Currently rather destroyed, he will only interact with you through calling a phonebooth near you, or any similar equivalent action should those not exist, to give you a riddle. Successfully completing it will give you something useful to your current circumstances. Should you do enough riddles, and have the skill, you can get his location and rebuild him. At which point he will assist you in combat with his saber, looking like a traditional gentleman with a handlebar mustache and a grinning metal half mask. The riddles stay though.

Name: Marble Beans
Short Description: A small bag containing six marble beans, as well as care and crafting instructions. Once planted will eventually grow into a marble shrub. Experimenting with the beans will result in being able to grow different types of marble, but by default its high quality white marble. You get a bag of seeds every week.

Name: Papal Armory
Short Description: You've been blessed! The Pope has sanctioned your violence and bestowed unto you a Casket of Firepower! Within this standard sized coffin is a large number of guns, explosives, stakes, melee weapons, and various other implements of carnage. They're significantly more effective against the unholy and the sinner, but significantly less effective against anyone else. Ammo is restored weekly by the casket emitting a cross shaped beam of light. This is only possible while it is closed, and objects not within the casket will not be reloaded. Though spare ammo will still appear.

Name: Preyer
Short Description: For your sins, you have been selected by the Vatican to become a Preyer. You are given a full face mask of a design you choose and altered into an undying weapon against Witches and the unholy. Destroying witches and other magic things will grant you Witchfire, which you can use to improve your abilities. Additionally, you are given the blessing of God, allowing you to occasionally ignore damage from an attack, strike critically, or double rewards from a chest or similar container. Should you be killed, you will respawn in the nearest holy place bereft of Witchfire. You may still be permanently killed by magical effects or entities with a high Myth rating, signaled by damage or destruction of your mask.

Name: Applied Mathematics
Short Description: You can apply math to things you do. This allows to to modify the principles related to the object which are expressed through mathematical formula. Increase the tensile strength of wood or the acceleration of a bullet. Set air resistance to nothing or so high it's impossible to move. Increase or decrease gravity! More extensive changes take much longer to apply and require more complex formula. Changes are permanent until the effect is ended or resolved through outside interference.

Name: The Any Gun
Short Description: A sealed box containing a firearm and parts for said firearm. It starts out in a pistol configuration, but can be modified using the parts to utilize any caliber of bullet and serve as any form of gun from pistol to anti-material light machine gun. Parts restock every month, one hundred rounds of the caliber the gun is currently set to included.

Name: Don
Short Description: Through a convoluted series of events, you are now the current head of a large criminal organization. They heavily value adherence to the hierarchy, so you won't be questioned in the short term. Though you will have to justify your decisions to the other ranking members eventually. Their reach is quite far, and they have at least some ability at the vast majority of blue collar crime. While whatever serves as police in the region is aware of them, they aren't generally interested in attempting to arrest the whole family.

Name: Pondering Orb Catalogue
Short Description: A completely normal catalogue that allows you to purchase orbs in a variety of shapes. Give them anything, even a picture of someone, and they will craft an orb that either looks like that or contains it. Or the closest approximation if the actual object cannot be obtained. All orbs glow when being stared into.

Name: Succubus Diet
Short Description: You may now subsist entirely off of sexual fluids. In fact, consuming such improves your constitution and significantly restores energy, with the exact increase being based on both how much you consume, how healthy the person you consumed from is, and how powerful that person is.

Name: Clothes in a Can
Short Description: A spray can that, when used on a naked individual, covers them in pain that looks exactly like very tight clothing. The style of clothing generated is marked on the can and the paint is realistic enough to pass cursory inspection. More focused inspection, especially from up close, will instantly give it away. More cans can be ordered through a handy catalogue, appearing in a box at the entrance to your current residence.

Name: Nude Camera
Short Description: This polaroid camera boasts infinite film! Anyone photographed with it will also appear entirely nude. There is no way to turn that off. Good for blackmail at least...

Name: Princess Dress
Short Description: An overly frilly, albeit somehow still breathable and easy to move in, pink dress. When worn anyone attempting to attack you will be compelled to capture you instead, though once you are captured they will do with you as they will. Should the dress be removed the effect will end immediately.

Name: Latex Manipulation
Short Description: Allows the generation and control of latex in any way you wish. Shape it into weapons, armor, or anything else you can think of. By default you may summon enough to completely cover yourself in a thin layer, but this may be improved with training. The latex is stronger than normal and becomes even stronger with training.

Name: Nipple Pasties of Decency
Short Description: A pair of X shaped black nipple pasties. When worn you are considered by all authorities as being properly covered, regardless of how much else you're wearing. Does not count as a uniform or proper dress for high end establishments or events. Doesn't mean you won't scandalize people on the streets.

Name: Whore's Lipstick
Short Description: A vibrantly colored tube of lipstick. When applied, the user may choose the color and any additional effects, so long as they are appropriately vibrant. Anyone who sees the lips of someone wearing this lipstick will be struck with sudden intrusive thoughts of recieving oral sex from the user. The lipstick will not smudge and can only be removed when the user deliberately wants to do so.

Name: Goblin Musk Perfume
Short Description: One endless perfume bottle crafted of only the finest hentai goblin smell. When worn it serves as a light aphrodasiac and is mildly addictive. Especially effective on nuns, elves, and virgins. While the user is immune to the effects of the perfume they still smell it.

Name: Universal Milking Machine
Short Description: A single easily portable box containing everything required to set up, maintain, use, tear down, and store a milking machine. This machine will work on any entity or thing capable of being milked, no matter the size, shape, acidity, heat, or any other potential complication from the milk it extracts. Always extracts the milk into properly labeled glass bottles, of which it has an endless supply. Pasteurization optional.

Name: Box of Infinite Cake
Short Description: A wooden box. When opened has a single slice of the cake you most want. Closing and opening it again spawns a new slice of cake.

Name: Kigurumi Set
Short Description: An entire bag of kigurumi. When someone reaches into the bag they will pull out a full skinsuit and mask featuring whatever fictional character they are thinking of. Or a generic anthropomorphic animal. Clothing not included. The skinsuit will always fit, regardless of size or height differences, and fully putting one on will transform you physically into that individual. Though the transformation is only skin deep, with allowances for intimate areas to work properly. While you look and sound just like them, you gain no powers or abiltiies. Removal can be done by pulling down the zipper as normal. Putting the suit back in the bag will clean and repair it.

Name: The Original
Short Description: A futuristic, tan rocket launcher with a metal handle and exhaust port, the muzzle has a distinct bulb shape. All rockets fired from this launcher will always go in a straight line, never curving or diverging of their path. If shot under your feet, it won't kill you but it will send you flying through the sky (Speed affects the distance and height you are launched from).

Name: Personal Domain Expansion
Short Description: Manifest into reality your domain- an are in which all of your abilities, skills, passives, and everything else are at their most powerful. This may either be closed, preventing anyone inside from leaving but rendering it easy to break open from outside, or open, making it simple to leave but much more difficult to break. The range of the domain may be expanded with practice. Also get a cool special attack that may only be used within the domain.

Name: Boob Reload
Short Description: Through bouncing, you are capable of reloading any weapon in your possession by bouncing ammo out of your breasts. This is just as fast as you could reload normally. As a bonus, you may now store a single reload of any handheld weapon between your breasts with no issue.

Name: Divine Fist of the North Star
Short Description: An ancient martial art that dates back thousands of years. It primarily focuses on hitting the opponent's ki/meridian points in order to cause effects ranging from dislocation to death. This knowledge may also be used in medically. You recieve the knowledge of everything required to enable yourself to properly use this style of combat, though it will take training to actually use it.

Name: Perfect Mantra Reactor
Short Description: A reactor of mystical energy. This may be implanted into your body to gather the energy that is generated when you are emotional. Once the reactor is full, it may be activated to grant a surge of immense strength and will to finish your current objective.

Name: Fertility Goddess Embodiment
Short Description: Divinity has embraced you. You are now the newest Goddess of Fertility, having power over all aspects of life. If you were not female, you are now. You gain access to your godly form- an incredibly voluptuous figure that you may stay in indefinitely as your base or transform into using an erotic dance. As part of your domain, you may heal, modify, or change any form of life from the smallest plants to the largest animals. Humans and yourself included. Though your own form will always be obviously feminine and voluptuous and refuse to change into something else. There is no limit to the modifications you can make as a Goddess. Equally, you may also deny your domain from access, rendering places entirely barren up to killing individuals. Though doing so pains you greatly as it is the opposite of your existence. As a Goddess you may give blessings, or curses, of fertility, and may be prayed to for these or other requests. As a new goddess, you are not instantly practiced with all of this, but it will become natural over time.

Name: Collection of Colored Herbs
Short Description: A briefcase containing a large sample of various herbs. They are unhelpfully unlabeled, simply being called 'Green Herb', 'Red Herb', 'Blue Herb', and similar. These herbs are exceptionally good medical items, especially when combined, and are rather simple to plant and raise. Provided they are planted in the right climate.

Name: Hassan-i-Sabah Invitation
Short Description: You have been selected to apply to become the next Hassan-i-Sabbah. This takes the form of a scroll that, when placed upon an altar and prayed to, will summon the shades of the Hassan-i-Sabah to judge you. Not only must you demonstrate great ability at stealth and efficient killing, but you must also present a technique of your own making that you will utilize as part of your duties. In addition, your moral character will be judged and failing too badly may have you executed by The First Hassan. Being successful grants you access to the Hassahashin archive and the ability to summon and wear the traditional outfit of the Hassan. Though you will also occasionally recieve instructions to kill a specific person.

Name: Renamon
Short Description: An digital entity that looks like an anthropomorphic fox. She does not need to eat, sleep, or have any other biological requirements, though she can still do such things if she wants. A dangerous fighter that, when pressed and after having gained enough experience, digivolve into a more powerful form. Has the ability to cast illusions and summon spikes of crystal to throw at enemies. Doesn't technically have any biological sex. With enough skill, her base code can be changed, provided she trusts you enough and gives permission.

Name: Golden Eagle
Short Description: A Golden Desert Eagle with a Radioactive symbol etched in both the handle and barrel. Duke Nukem's prized pistol from a defunct game. Comes loaded, with two extra magazines.

Name: Excalipoor
Short Description: The shining sword of legend...? Seems a little underpowered, but talk about legendary handling!

Name: Eyes of the Hierophant
Short Description: You can now see magic on its most fundamental and basic level and also see through walls. Also your eyes are now glass and glowing. Good luck understanding what you see.

Name: Night
Short Description: The ability to harvest power and knowledge from the dead. Theft through murder, as granted by the sisters Sve Noc. Grows quickly.

Name: Scud-B Launcher (R-17 Elbrus)
Short Description: A MAZ-543 Uragan 8x8 Transporter-Erector Launcher truck with an R-17 Elbrus tactical ballistic missile. No magic involved. Comes with one missile. Does not auto-restock. Comes with a full tank of gas.

Name: R-17 Elbrus Reloads (Conventional)
Short Description: Exactly as stated. Comes with 5 missiles. If the Scud-B Launcher (R-17 Elbrus) is present, also comes with all equipment necessary to reload the truck. User is given the knowledge necessary to load the missiles.

Name: Scud-B Launcher (R-17 Elbrus) (Nuclear)
Short Description: MAZ-543 Uragan 8x8 Transporter-Erector Launcher truck with an R-17 Elbrus tactical ballistic missile with a 5-70 kiloton nuclear warhead. No magic involved. Comes with one missile. Does not auto-restock. Comes with a full tank of gas.

Name: R-17 Elbrus Reloads (Nuclear)
Short Description: Exactly as stated. Comes with 5 variable yield nuclear missiles. If the Scud-B Launcher (R-17 Elbrus) is present, also comes with all equipment necessary to reload the truck. User is given the knowledge necessary to load the missiles.

Name: One PB&J Sandwich
Short Description: A peanut butter and jelly sandwich. Tastes good.

Name: Nuclear Missile Silo (Empty)
Short Description: A below-ground nuclear missile silo. Don't ask how it got there. Accommodates all ICBMs and ICBM-shaped missiles made up until the year 2026, as well as anything smaller. Empty.

Name: Nuclear Missile Silo (Full)
Short Description: A below-ground nuclear missile silo. Don't ask how it got there. Accommodates all ICBMs and ICBM-shaped missiles made up until the year 2026, as well as anything smaller. Select one singular missile to be housed within.

Name: Nuclear Missile Silo Reloads
Short Description: You get one free nuclear missile of your choosing. If you do not have either a full or empty Nuclear Missile Silo, the missile exists in an inventory until summoned.

Name: UNCF Yamato (2199)
Short Description: The UNCF Yamato from the Space Battleship Yamato remake series, circa 2199. Contains Analyser. Exists in inventory space until summoned. Does not go back.

Name: Isekai Restaurant
Short Description: Congratulations! You are now the owner of an izakaya! It accommodates 40 patrons in the main area, has a record player, a fully stocked kitchen, an employee break room, and a refrigerated basement with cargo elevator. Once a week, a magic doorway opens to another realm bringing guests you can cook for.

Name: Lore Accurate Follower Dagoth-Ur
Short Description: You gain the modded version of Dagoth-Ur as your follower. You poor sod. No, he will not put clothes on.

Name: Your New Home
Short Description: A home in your name. Common room, small kitchen, two bedrooms, shared bathing area. Cozy. Inviting. Warm. Customizable. Adds onto any owned property.

Name: The Web's Gambit
Short Description: An entity known as the Web has ported every entity from the Magnus Archives into your world. Good Luck. More of a curse, really...

Name: Diavolo's Blankie of Coziness
Short Description: The coziest blanket in existence. Indestructible. Perfectly comfortable. Comes with a plushie of your liking.

Name: Artoria Caster
Short Description: Fairy Britain's Child of Prophecy, Artoria Caster. Functionally the version from Lostbelt 6: Avalon le Fae. Not dependent on you as a Servant normally is for mana and is her own person. She has access to all her skills she possessed in life.

Name: Koyanskaya of Light
Short Description: A pink haired fox girl in a leather catsuit. She is hyper competent in all manner of skills befitting a successful business woman, professional assassin and sexy secretary. She has access to all her Skills as an Assassin class servant. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Melusine
Short Description: Fairy Knight Lancelot, Melusine is a short and charming knight, born from the decaying corpse of Albion the last dragon. As your familiar she is strong, fast and merciless to your enemies. She has access to all her abilities as her Lancer self, and is not dependent on your mana to continue existing. Requires effort to maintain bond.

Name: Ibuki Douji
Short Description: A goddess made flesh, the daughter of Yamata-no-Orochi. A care free big sister type, but don't mistake her for being harmless. 3 meters tall, with purple skin and teal and pink hair. Has access to all the skills and abilities her Saber, Berserker and Ruler selves had and more. Is not dependent on you for mana. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: DETERMINATION vial
Short Description: One syringe containing a vial of DETERMINATION equal to about one half of one of the 6 Human SOULs. Increases your ability to survive certain death, also improves magical potency and resistance against time manipulation. WARNING: Do not inject inside inorganic beings.

Name: Ereshkigal
Short Description: You gain Ereshkigal, Sumerian Goddess of the Underworld as your ally. A goddess made flesh with access to the many powers she holds as Kur's Queen. Is not reliant on you to supply mana. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Mysterious Heroine XX
Short Description: A blonde space cop wielding a magic mecha armor spacesuit. Has access to all her skills as a Foreigner class Servant but does not require you to supply mana. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Pickle Jar
Short Description: happines +1 :)

Name: Astolfo
Short Description: The pink haired paladin of Charlemagne is summoned as your ally. He has all the abilities of his Rider and Saber selves. Not dependent on you to maintain his existence. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Artoria Pendragon (Saber)
Short Description: Artoria Pendragon, the King of Knights is summoned as your ally. Has all her abilities as a Saber servant with the bonus of also having Avalon. Does not depend on you to provide her mana. Is still an extreme glutton. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Goddess Rhongomyniad
Short Description: Artoria Pendragon, the Goddess Rhongomyniad is summoned as your ally. Wields the Lance of World's End, Rhongomyniad, and the might of a goddess born from King Arthur. Has the powers of her Lancer and Ruler selves. Does not require you to supply her magic. Still an extreme glutton. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Medusa
Short Description: Medusa the Gorgon of Greek myth is summoned as your ally. Goddess of the earth and a mother of monsters. Appears as her Rider self, is capable of using her kaiju-sized Gorgon form. Has access to her abilities of her Rider, Lancer, and Avenger forms and more. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Barghest
Short Description: Barghest, the Fairie Knight Gawain, is summoned as your ally. Possesses all the abilities she had in life, except for the ability to become the Calamity. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond

Name: Osakabehime
Short Description: The Yokai protector of Himeji Castle, Osakabehime is a huge NEET! Capable of summoning hordes of shikigami to do battle, can also bring forth Himeji Castle as a reality marble. Has all her skills as her Assassin and Archer selves. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Vritra
Short Description: Vritra from Indian myth is an Evil Dragon with great mystic powers beyond most others. Also has all her abilities as her Lancer class self. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Medea
Short Description: The Witch of Betrayal is summoned as your ally. A master of magics lost to the modern era, capable of using Divine Words to enforce her will upon reality. Possesses mystic knowledge beyond the abilities of her Caster and Lily selves.Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Tamamo-no-Mae
Short Description: The orange haired, kitsune foxwife, Tamamo-no-Mae! A divinely blessed spell caster, wielding ofuda and the sacred mirror. Connected to Amaterasu-no-Omikami as her daughter. Has all the powers of her Caster and Lancer selves. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: Sodom's Beast / Draco
Short Description: Beast VI S Queen Draco is summoned as your ally. Appears in her larval form, in her red dress. Has access to her powers as Sodom's Beast and Queen Draco forms, can shift to any of the bodies at will. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Name: One (1) Vegas Exclusion
Short Description: Within one hour of starting an adventure, event, quest, or similar thing you may declare you are using this exclusion. When used, said adventure in its entirety is considered by all parties as not counting and not to be spoken about. You gain no fame, renown, or any form of recognition from any actions performed during said event, but will maintain items you personally aquired during such. This also doesn't wipe or remove being wanted by police, drug lords, or anyone you otherwise caused issues. Though they won't actively go after you directly as a result of the event- they must encounter you at another point afterward. The exlusion is consumed on use, but you can roll another.

Name: Fireball Bottles
Short Description: 10 50ml bottles of Fireball Cinnamon Whiskey (Warning: Not a fireball, this is a drink)

Name: Bottled Fireball
Short Description: 10 50ml bottles of liquid Fireball spell (Warning: Not a drink, this is a fireball)

Name: Fireball
Short Description: I didn't ask how big the room was, I said, I CAST FIREBALL!  Launch a bolt of fire from your fingertip up to 400ft with a 20 foot radius spherical explosion on impact. Hits with maximum damage at the center, 50% at the very edges. Ignites flammable objects.

Name: Nukem's Combat Harness
Short Description: A Black Combat harness that contains many utility pouches and three slots in each side for explosives. They can hold more ammo and explosives than they are physically capable of without encumbering the user. Getting another will simply double the amount of ammunition and explosives that you can hold.

Name: Box of Infinite Cigars
Short Description: A thin wooden box. When opened it will reveal a set of cigars that the user desired, said cigars can be modified to not have any negative side-effects and even have different tastes. When closing and opening the box it will make a new set of cigars appear.

Name: Pack of Infinite Bubblegum
Short Description: A cardboard pack of nondescript bubblegum. When opened it will show a few pieces of bubblegum that the user prefers. When closed and opened again spawns another set of bubblegum.

Name: Haigure Human
Short Description: Generic servants wearing high cut leotards. They do not have their brainwashing guns, but could rebuild them with materials. They do a weird dance sometimes.

Name: Raptor Squad
Short Description: A pack of four genetically engineered Velociraptors named Blue, Delta, Echo, and Charlie. They are trained and can follow simple commands. They are led by Blue, who is exceptionally intelligent and empathic. Blue can follow more complex commands and ride herd on the other three.

Name: Pizza Time!
Short Description: The entire classic Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. Just dropped on the nearest empty space that can fit it.

Name: Special Seeds
Short Description: A singular seed pack that will grow a random plant from hit series Plants Vs Zombies when planted. Once planted, changes the seed packet to that plant type permanently.

Name: Constraints and Amplification
Short Description: At any time, you may place a Constraint upon yourself. In exchange you Amplify either yourself or an ally based on the level of Constraint. Removing your ability to move your left index finger won't provide much power, but temporarily putting yourself completely unconcious will provide an immense boost of power.

Name: Animatronic
Short Description: We here at Fazbear Entertainment are not at fault for having turned your body into one of our expertly crafted Endoskeletons. Neither we are at fault that your soul may have possesed the Endoskeleton and given it far more fexibility and paranormal abilities than it should ever have. Please look at clause 1-9b-87A as you can clearly see you can't sue us. As a gesture of goodwill, we will offer you one of our existing mascot suits to wear for free! A custom suit may be ordered, but such a thing will require additional payment.

Name: Twili Impification
Short Description: You're been turned into a Twili. What's more, you've been futher cursed into a Twili Imp. You are exceptionally short, with long hair and an overly large bottom. Your hair is prehensile and entirely under your control, even able to lengthen or shorten at will. Suitable to attack... or reach high shelves. This form comes with levitation and the ability to become and travel through shadows, though the touch of the sun severly weakens you and light based attacks risk destroying you entirely. Darkness or shadow based magical powers come far more easily to this form.

Name: Style Meter
Short Description: Whenever you enter combat, a bar will suddenly appear. Performing stylish actions will increase the rating, while repeating the same thing will decrease it. This bar goes from 'Dull' to 'Smokin' Sexy Style', and each rank is declared by an unseen bombastic announcer. At the conclusion of the fight you will gain a monetary reward based on your rating.

Name: Skeleton Time
Short Description: Everything bar your bones has decided you are rather icky and they no longer wish to be associated with you. On one hand, this has not resulted in your death, on the other, you are now an animate skeleton. You can no longer eat, drink, breathe, or perform other functions which require present internal organs. Nor do you need to do any of those to continue your existence. Unfortunately, you don't have any natural protection on your bones, and need to continue to utilize things which are necessary to keeping them strong. Mostly by pouring them on yourself. You do not qualify as undead, cursed, or anything else to divine, mystical, or other senses.

Name: Doyen's Virility Pills
Short Description: A vial of 100 pills that increase endurance and fertility in bed. Try not to take more than one at a time.

Name: Scrap Iron Candy
Short Description: A bag of candies that taste like scrap metal. Bolsters user's defense for 30 minutes.

Name: Super Absorbent Sponge
Short Description: A sponge capable of holding up to a billion liters of water within. Does not increase in size or weight despite that.

Name: Succubus
Short Description: Hells claim you. You are now an unholy monster- a demon that can only sustain herself off of sexual fluids. Oh, you're a girl if you weren't before. You are supernaturally tempting, able to charm people by your very presence and utilize magic to do so more forcefully. Shapeshifting comes naturally, but exclusively into things generally considered 'sexy' by the public or into something considered as such by a specific individual you are around. As a bonus, your strength, speed, and balance are increased and you gain some ability with a whip and dancing- especially pole dancing. Divine and mystical sources identify you as a demon, and anti-demon objects will work on you.

Name: Bottle of Endless Lotion
Short Description: A simple bottle of slimy lotion that never runs out. Must be squeezed out manually. Tampering just breaks the effect.

Name: Gordon's Crowbar
Short Description: A crowbar used to kill unfathomable amounts of aliens and mutated enemies. Nearly unbreakable. Does extra damage to nonhuman enemies

Name: Morphing Blade
Short Description: A 3kg iron sword capable of changing shape while retaining mass. Destroyed or detached parts lose the effect. Reforging the sword removes the effect as well.

Name: Black Knight Set
Short Description: A set of armor and weapons wielded by the Black Knights of Lordran. Perfectly fitted to your body no matter the change (within reason). Contains a greatsword, battle axe, halberd, sword, and shield.

Name: Centaur
Short Description: The lower half of your body is now that of a horse. At least you can run fast now. You can choose your own coat patterns too.

Name: One For All (Yoichi)
Short Description: Yoichi's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Does not include physical enhancement.

Name: One For All (Kudo)
Short Description: Kudo's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes mild physical enhancement (and Yoichi's ghost). Could unlock a weak Gearshift if enhanced enough.

Name: One For All (Bruce)
Short Description: Bruce's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes moderate physical enhancement (and Yoichi and Kudo's ghosts). Could unlock a weak Gearshift/Fa Jin if enhanced enough.

Name: One For All (Hikage)
Short Description: Hikage's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes notable physical enhancement (and Yoichi, Kudo, and Bruce's ghosts). Could unlock a weak Gearshift/Fa Jin/Danger Sense if enhanced enough.

Name: One For All (Banjo)
Short Description: Banjo's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes significant physical enhancement (and Yoichi, Kudo, Bruce, and Hikage's ghosts). Could unlock a weak Gearshift/Fa Jin/Danger Sense/Black Whip if enhanced enough.

Name: One For All (En)
Short Description: En's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes notable physical enhancement (and Yoichi, Kudo, Bruce, Hikage, and Banjo's ghosts). Could unlock a weak Gearshift/Fa Jin/Danger Sense/Black Whip/Smokescreen if enhanced enough.

Name: One For All (Nana)
Short Description: Nana's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes major physical enhancement (and Yoichi, Kudo, Bruce, Hikage, Banjo, and En's ghosts). Could unlock a weak Gearshift/Fa Jin/Danger Sense/Black Whip/Smokescreen/Float if enhanced enough.

Name: One For All (Toshinori)
Short Description: Toshinori's version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes extreme physical enhancement (and Yoichi, Kudo, Bruce, Hikage, Banjo, En, and Nana's ghosts). Could unlock a weak Gearshift/Fa Jin/Danger Sense/Black Whip/Smokescreen/Float if enhanced enough.

Name: One For All (Izuku)
Short Description: Izuku's final version of One For All. Allows you to transfer this and one other ability to someone else via genetic consumption (ie, eat a hair/blood/etc). Includes potentially body-breaking physical enhancement (and Yoichi, Kudo, Bruce, Hikage, Banjo, En, Nana, and Toshinori's ghosts). Could unlock Gearshift/Fa Jin/Danger Sense/Black Whip/Smokescreen/Float if enhanced enough.

Name: Rexy
Short Description: A tyrannosaurus rex. Genetically modified, because that was an amazing idea. Rexy is smart enough to determine friend and foe and learn. Oddly stealthy. Also exceptionally territorial and not very interested in roaming.

Name: ARMS!
Short Description: Wuzzah! Your arms are now large springs and your pupils have twisted into spirals. Gain vastly increased upper body strength, even more increased punching strength, and much less improved lower body strength. Your arms can stretch a large distance and can maneuver mid strike in ways that are unintuitive to anything that doesn't consider your entire arm length a movement point. Switching out your fists for other weapons is possible, but you must research and aquire them yourself.

Name: Helltaker's Apron
Short Description: A black apron with the word "SATAN" embroidered on the front in white. Enhances your ability to learn cooking skills, especially pancakes.

Name: Father Garcia's Trenchcoat
Short Description: A shotgun used to fight demons and evil spirits. Can gun down intangible entities. Extra damage against Unholy entities

Name: Clergy Robes
Short Description: The black and white robes of a clergyman. Durable enough to resist daily wear and tear. Minor resistance to darkness, curses, negative energy, and evil when worn.

Name: Nun Robes
Short Description: The black and white robes of a nun. Durable enough to resist daily wear and tear. Minor resistance to darkness, curses, negative energy, and evil when worn.

Name: Sexy Nun Robes
Short Description: Punish me daddy, I've been naughty~ Sexy nun robes that grant minor defense against unholy, darkness, evil, curses, and negativity. You decide what they look like and how revealing they are.

Name: Lon Lon Milk
Short Description: A bottle of high quality milk from Malon. Restores vitality and vigor when drunk.

Name: Beginner Acting
Short Description: The skill of a novice actor. You improve much faster at acting than others. You can hide emotion and portray a character, but you're no expert

Name: Beginner Programming
Short Description: The skill of a novice programmer. You improve much faster at programming than others. You can make simple programs and understand code in any coding language you've seen

Name: Beginner Chemistry
Short Description: The skill of a novice chemist. You improve much faster at chemistry work than others. You can make basic chemicals in a lab and know a fair amount of compounds.

Name: Beginner Interfacing
Short Description: The skill of a novice thief. You can pick basic locks, pick pockets, maneuver around mechanisms, and move with decent grace

Name: Beginner Stealth
Short Description: The skill of a novice at stealth. You can mask your footsteps, sneak up on people, check for traps, and gather information discreetly. You're no expert, though.

Name: Beginner Fine Arts
Short Description: The skill of a novice artist. You improve much faster at the arts than others. You are a beginner at painting, engraving, sculpting, sketching, etc. You've got a long way to go.

Name: SUPERHOT
Short Description: Time moves as you move. The faster you move, the faster time progresses. While you stand still, time stands still. It is possible for people to break out of or ignore this effect.

Name: Boggart's Boiling Brilliance
Short Description: You are now a master of boiling and cooking crab, prawn, lobster, and other crustaceans in general. You are invited to the crawfish boil. As the head chef.

Name: Blood Pack
Short Description: You now have an anime character's amount of blood in you. Prepare to gush like a fountain when injured.

Name: Larger than Life
Short Description: You now have a much larger presence, even if your physical body is small, people will think you tower over them.

Name: Chompers
Short Description: Your teeth are big, durable, and strong. You can literally chew rocks like it's nothing. You never have to worry about dental health again, and your teeth will grow back slowly when broken.

Name: Deviant Fashion
Short Description: You can wear whatever you want with no legal moral consequences. People might be uncomfortable though. Yes, that includes nudity.

Name: Attention
Short Description: You can now create a very distinct, eye catching, and distracting aura around yourself. The opposite of stealth.

Name: Void Mirror Image
Short Description: You can make illusory clones of yourself to serve as distractions. They cannot attack physically.

Name: Double Jump
Short Description: You now have a second jump in mid-air, as if the air itself is solid for just one moment. Landing does not hurt you as long as you land at the same height you started. After that, it's up to your own ability to handle a fall.

Name: Tech Tree: Ranged Weapons
Short Description: Allows you to design, modify, and build any tech related to ranged weapons. Starts mundane, increases with access to better materials and tools.

Name: Induce Lactation
Short Description: Allows you to induce lactation on targets within line of sight. Only works on mammals or other creatures capable of producing milk. Anything with tits, really.

Name: Afterlife Denied
Short Description: Heaven has closed the gates and Hell has barred your entry. No afterlife will accept you, your soul left to wander the mortal world for all time. On one hand, this kinda sucks because plenty of things can definitely tell. On the other, as long as you properly set up some contingencies, being ressurected is significantly easier. Just avoid any attacks which can harm or trap your soul.

Name: Tongue Lash
Short Description: You can stretch your tongue to dozens of meters long. Use it as a whip, another limb, a restraint... something else... hint hint.

Name: Dire Wolf
Short Description: A man-sized, rideable wolf. Default female. Very strong, tough, and vicious.

Name: Wooloo
Short Description: A cute, round sheep Pokemon that rolls around a lot and has fast growing, luxurious wool. Not... particularly intelligent. Does not come with a pokeball.

Name: Minecraft Chicken
Short Description: A weird, square chicken. Comes in one of three varieties. Immune to fall damage. Lays one egg every five to ten minutes regardless of sustenance. Eggs thrown at the ground have a 12.5% chance of spawning another chicken. Both egg and chicken meat taste great. Start with one breeding pair. Eats seeds and other chicken related things. Doesn't poop, though...?

Name: Holy Cow
Short Description: A literally holy cow. Large, healthy, always lactating. Can be milked for up to 50 liters of milk a day depending on food consumption. Milk provides health benefits, is nutrient dense, and is low grade holy water. The holiness breeds true.

Name: Cancerous Rodent
Short Description: A nasty looking green rat that constantly emits a toxic dose of radiation

Name: Investing-Gator
Short Description: An alligator that's a master of the stock market and the free market. Guaranteed to reap large returns. This one's really stretching the gator joke...

Name: Reach Out and Touch Someone
Short Description: When interacting with someone through any medium, you may phyiscally interact with them through that medium. So yes, you can punch that internet troll in the face through their computer screen.

Name: Amulet of Health
Short Description: A gold amulet with a ruby gem in the center. Slightly increases vitality and health.

Name: 0 - The Fool
Short Description: Temporarily grants a skill or minor ability best suited for the situation at hand. Cannot be higher rated than The Fool.

Name: I - The Magician
Short Description: Increase the ranking of an ability at or below the card's rank for one hour

Name: II - The High Priestess
Short Description: Temporarily speeds up perception, emulating bullet time. Gives precognition for 30 minutes.

Name: III - The Empress
Short Description: Creates an aura that increases defense and recovery on the user for 30 minutes

Name: IV - The Emperor
Short Description: Creates immense mental pressure to dominate or crush the mind of a target

Name: V - The Hierophant
Short Description: Dispels all illusions C rank or lower within line of sight for one hour

Name: VI - The Lovers
Short Description: Copy any one ability from someone within 100 meters range for one hour

Name: VII - The Chariot
Short Description: Teleport to any location within your perception, even through a camera. Has five uses.

Name: VIII - Strength
Short Description: Increases all physical stats and abilities and lowers sense of pain for 30 minutes.

Name: IX - The Hermit
Short Description: Allows you to read minds and thoughts within perceptual range for one hour

Name: X - Wheel of Fortune
Short Description: Swaps all active abilities for random powers of the same rank for one hour

Name: XI - Justice
Short Description: Cleanses all abnormal status effects like disease, poison, curses, and charms below A rank in a 10 meter radius.

Name: XII - The Hanged Man
Short Description: Absorb all of the wounds and ailments of a target and take them on at 50% severity

Name: XIII - Death
Short Description: Destroy any active physical or magical effect on contact, including speed, rituals, reanimation, enhanced strength, etc. Five uses.

Name: XIV - Temperance
Short Description: Complete mental clarity and focus, dispels all negative mental conditions for one hour.

Name: XV - The Devil
Short Description: Summons infernal chains to bind and weaken a target

Name: XVI - The Tower
Short Description: Release a wave of destructive energy that could partially destroy several city blocks. Partially ignores durability. Disorients enemies.

Name: XVII - The Star
Short Description: Restores all energy and stamina and resets ability cooldowns on use. Five uses.

Name: XVIII - The Moon
Short Description: Construct an illusionary world to fools all senses for one hour

Name: XIX - The Sun
Short Description: Recovers all health instantly, resets item cooldowns, repairs all equipment. Five uses.

Name: XX - Judgement
Short Description: Compels a target to tell the truth without being able to trick you. One hour duration. Two uses.

Name: XXI - The World
Short Description: Permanently fuse two abilities of the same rank and receive an appropriate ability one rank higher

Name: The Major Arcana
Short Description: Grants all 22 Major Arcana Tarot Cards at once, and their effects.

Name: Fate Draw
Short Description: Roll a random number from 0 to 21 and invoke the effect of the Tarot card it lands on.

Name: Standard Reading Major Arcana
Short Description: Roll a random number from 0 to 21 three times and invoke the abilities of those three Major Arcana cards

Name: Infinite Bowl of Spaghetti
Short Description: A bowl containing an endless amount of hot and fresh spaghetti that you can always take more servings from. Comes with sauce, meatballs, and all the parmesan on top you could ever want.

Name: Can of Pain
