Short Description: A can of unbranded cola that causes anyone who drinks it immense agony for five minutes straight. Only really good for pranks?

Name: Stack of Gold Bars
Short Description: 33 kg of pure gold bars

Name: Courier's Stash
Short Description: A briefcase with lightweight metal armor, a double barreled shotgun with 20 packs of 20 shells, 4 basic repair kits, and 5 stim packs

Name: 1 Star Heart Ticket
Short Description: Affection in a ticket. Rip it and the person you think about likes you a little more via retcon and causality bending. No side effects but your own guilt.

Name: Shadow Perfume
Short Description: A bottle of pitch black perfume that erases all scent from the user and moderately muffles all movements and actions for 1 hour

Name: Mantis Flip Coin
Short Description: A Shen Gong Wu coin as a simple pendant. Flip the coin and you gain incredible acrobatic skills, even jumping multiple stories at once.

Name: Tacticool Trenchcoat
Short Description: A really tactical, cool, durable, high quality trench coat guaranteed to not make you look like a loser. Has pockets that are ten times bigger on the inside. You always know what you're looking for in them.

Name: Excalibur's Rock
Short Description: The rock that Arthur pulled the sword from. Indestructible to anything below A rank damage. Also still a big heavy rock just about 3 feet tall and wide at the base. Makes you more kingly, supposedly.

Name: Caledfwlch
Short Description: A king's sword. High quality, proof of your divine right to rule the British Isles. Emits flashes of light when drawn in combat. Onlookers will inexplicably think of you as both a king and Welsh.

Name: Caliburn
Short Description: A king's sword. High quality, proof of your divine right to rule the British Isles. Emits flashes of light when drawn in combat. Onlookers will inexplicably think of you as both a king and Welsh.

Name: Excalibur
Short Description: A king's sword. High quality, proof of your divine right to rule the British Isles. Emits flashes of light when drawn in combat. Onlookers will inexplicably think of you as both a king and Welsh.

Name: Excalibur's Scabbard
Short Description: A magic, holy scabbard. Its owners wounds do not bleed, preventing exsanguination in battle.

Name: Job Application Form
Short Description: A job application form that, when filled out properly, guarantees hiring at any job you choose. Not guaranteed to keep it though. One use only.

Name: Super Rod
Short Description: A fishing rod that lures in fish automatically, no bait needed. More likely to attract powerful sea dwelling creatures more than not.

Name: Killer Frost I
Short Description: A frosty, bitter metahuman with powers of cold and ice, seeking revenge for a wrongful death (Hers). Very good at killing people in multiple ways with her powers.

Name: Killer Frost II
Short Description: A frosty, bitter metahuman with powers of cold and ice, seeking revenge for a wrongful death (Crystal's). Very good at killing people in multiple ways with her powers.

Name: Killer Frost III
Short Description: A frosty, bitter metahuman with powers of cold and ice, seeking revenge for a wrongful death (Her own, kinda). Very good at killing people in multiple ways with her powers.

Name: Black Rose Armor
Short Description: A set of black and red armor with rose heraldry originally used by Maple in New World Online. When destroyed the armor will automatically reform on the wearer stronger than it was previously. Give excellent boosts to defense and vitality. Also grants the ability for the user to turn into a massive four-armed demon that oddly resembles a pillbug. This form serves as a second life, and dying in this form will simply return you back to your state immediately prior to using the ability. You gain no equipment bonuses while in this form.

Name: Dark Matterification
Short Description: Congratulations! You have now become a mass of dark energy/matter born from a condensation of negative emotions! You can fly, possess people, copy elemental abilities, shapeshift, and more! However you are significantly more prone to spiraling into darker emotions and will be far weaker to attacks that use positive or heartfelt emotions! Don't let the Power of Friendship erase you from existence!

Name: Just Beat It!
Short Description: Whenever a fight begins a song begins playing. Acting in time with the beat of the song enhances your actions.

Name: CRITICAL
Short Description: When in a fight, you will see a white flash or similar indicator on occasion. Hitting that spot, or acting at that specific timing, will result in your attack dealing double damage! Though your enemy can notices these flashes as well and even figure out what they mean. Potentially allowing them to use them to trap you or predict your movements.

Name: Kuugen'd
Short Description: Breasts are large, women are lesbian, and the men are unseen. Welcome to Kuugenland, enjoy your stay. Oddly less skimpy than expected. Expect opportunities for (boob) growth, people starting businesses for passion, universal basic income, and lesbians. Yes, it really does have to be stated twice.

Name: Herald of Orignium
Short Description: Orignium is a semi-transparent black stone-like substance with a glowing yellow core that can be used as an immensely potent power source and incredibly large data storage. Within the mass of Orignium is  the Assimilated Universe, where all of the information Orignium records is stored, preserved, and can be altered or restored. Now it is under your control. While Orignium can serve as effectively a variant of stone control, it's true power is in the reality altering properties and information storage. Properly using Orignium, typically through a medium, allows people to use Arts- magic that can be studied, understood and taught. When Orignium comes into contact with biological matter, it will assimilate that matter into itself, creating a record of the entirety of that entity within the Assimilated Universe that you can do what you wish with- people included. This is not a fast process, and you can control or stop it. Being infected in this way allows naturally casting Arts without study, potentially to an extremely powerful degree. Though at the cost of worsening Oripathy and eventually leading to death. Your body is also stored there, and can be altered just the same as anything else, as well as serving as a backup should you be horrifically injured or die.

Name: Nachzehrer
Short Description: A Sarkaz subrace- the Nachzehrer are generally slender, favoring robes and flowing fabric. They are most known for their predisposition to cannibalism and magic relating to causing necrosis in living organisms. While it is possible to resist this instinct, the hunger will never fade and you will eternally smell of decay should you partake. Often called 'Lords of War', a practived Nachzehrer is a terrifying opponent that rots and consumes their enemies to continually get stronger.

Name: Protoframe Virus
Short Description: Roll a number between 1-65. You are now the Protoframe of that specific Warframe. The transformation will be painful and take days, but you will be blessed with the default abilities of whatever Warframe you've become. You can train to improve those abilities beyond their in-game use. You keep your fun bits, btw, but they might be a little weird looking after the transformation. Choose your own appearance.

Name: Tony Tony Chopper
Short Description: Boku wa Docutah! Tony Tony Chopper! The Doctor of the Strawhats, Tony Tony Chopper is a genius in medicinal and pharmecutical work, and can also transform himself using his Rumble Balls. With the correct materials and modifications, he can improve his Rumble Balls to increase their effects. He comes with Nine Transformations, or Points. But Monster Point should only be used in an emergency. You'll have to work for him to consider you Nakama, Chopper has a hard time trusting.

Name: Captain Cooke's Specialties Recipes
Short Description: A small leatherbound booklet that smells of the sea. It is filled with many strange recipes for food that grant the consumer the knowledge on how to use incredible barehanded techniques! The ingredients can be a bit exotic, but you can still find them.

Name: Two Water Buckets
Short Description: Two water buckets that when splashed on the ground will create a seventy five centimeter deep pool of water. If both water buckets are used in a specific pattern, it will create infinite source of water. The buckets can also be used to contain any form of liquid from powdered snow to milk to lava.

Name: Limbo Blade
Short Description: A result of perfected alchemical process, a blade held delicately in the twilight of light and dark. Prevents curses and blindness from ailing the user and does both light and dark damage. Its true purpose is to kill what cannot die.

Name: Lucid Blade
Short Description: A 'magical' longsword used by an old royal wizard, capable of blasting waves of magic born from the moon. Its time under the well of madness has increased its potency against those that neither dream nor remain logical.

Name: "FIRE" Blade
Short Description: A dark steel hilt that, when held with conviction, will emit a flaming blade from the ricasso. It can illuminate any area you are in, except underwater.

Name: Icaraian Flight Ring
Short Description: A ring with that enhances the caster's jump ability for 2 seconds per jump. Be cautious of where you land.

Name: Rocinante
Short Description: A sentient pair of shoes/horse. Suppresses bloodfiend characteristics and maintains the illusion of humanity.

Name: Race Change Card
Short Description: When you roll a race change on the Gacha, it now becomes a physical card. Anyone holding the card can use it to apply the race change to themselves. Single use per card created.

Name: Fursona!
Short Description: Gives you a single use Evoker with a pawprint on the side. Yes, you must shout "Fursona!" when using it. Changes you directly into your fursona. If you don't have one, it assigns a random animal to be your fursona. You get to pick the design, at least.

Name: Crystal Spear
Short Description: A spear made of crystals that are stronger than steel. Can be used to cast magic, like a wand/staff

Name: Bunny's Blessings
Short Description: A bunny ear headband and matching tail buttplug. Increases charisma and sex appeal.

Name: Bronze Bag of Holding
Short Description: A hip bag woven from bronze thread, able to contain two thousand pounds worth of items. You automatically know how to find anything inside.

Name: Beginner Hand to Hand Combat
Short Description: You have a decent talent at any martial art you try. You could beat most people in a fight outside of professional fighters. Improves learning speed

Name: Beginner Math
Short Description: You can solve any math problem up to the level you've already learned in your head. Might take a bit, but it's not hard.

Name: Beginner Blunt Weapon Mastery
Short Description: You have a decent talent with any blunt weapon you try. You could beat most people in a fight outside of professional fighters. Improves learning speed

Name: Beginner Marital Arts
Short Description: You can fuck pretty well and know what a clitoris is, putting you solidly above the average person at sex.

Name: Beginner Medicine
Short Description: You can perform first aid, apply medicine, know what most medicines do, and improvise basic medical tools for field procedures. Improves learning speed.

Name: Healthy
Short Description: You're very healthy. Increases vitality, virility, and removes previous health complications prior to gaining this ticket.

Name: Blood Fuel
Short Description: Your blood functions as high quality fuel/power, allowing you to run anything that requires its own power source. Including electronics.

Name: Sexercise
Short Description: You can now substitute full body exercise with sex. Applies benefits after sex has ended, effect scales with quality of sex.

Name: Sprinkle
Short Description: Telekinetically control water with enough strength to remove moisture and act as a water gun

Name: Gust
Short Description: Create and control winds strong enough to injure or knock someone off their feet

Name: Metal Detector
Short Description: You can detect metals around you like a mental radar. The more valuable, the more distinct its presence. Starts with a 10 meter radius.

Name: Cosmetic Calibration
Short Description: You can change any cosmetic thing about your appearance, ability color, hair color, pupil shape, skin tone, etc.

Name: Leaf Blade
Short Description: Conjure a longsword sized leaf blade. Abnormally durable, razor sharp, still not as durable as normal steel. Also conjure smaller leaves as projectiles. Leaves are permanent, but lose lethality over time.

Name: Bubbling
Short Description: Encase targets in bubbles that slowly float upwards or hover in place. Each bubble is roughly as durable as 1cm thick glass (scales with power level). Damaged bubbles pop and vanish. Encasing yourself allows you to control movement direction.

Name: Rough Knuckle
Short Description: Augment your fists with energy, allowing even a normal man to shatter bricks and punch through stone walls. Not very efficient. More energy spent means more power.

Name: Hormone Regulation
Short Description: Control your own hormones at will, increase concentrations or lower them, regulate mood, cause bodily changes, so on and so forth. Be careful with your regulations.

Name: Soul Arrow
Short Description: Use your soul's energy to fire a mildly homing arrow at enemies. Power scales with soul's power and energy levels.

Name: Root
Short Description: Grow ethereal roots into the ground to drain energy and nutrients from the soil and increase vitality/energy regeneration. Roots you in place while in use.

Name: Snow Tiger
Short Description: A powerful snowy white tiger. Powerful and smart, larger than lions, big enough to ride. Default female.

Name: Skeleton Band
Short Description: A group of skeletons that can play any instrument and comes with its own equipment. Cannot enter combat, cannot be harmed. Summon and pick a playlist for them to play. They fall apart and reassemble comedically when struck.

Name: Golden Goose
Short Description: A regular looking goose that lays a golden egg every 24 hours. Will be gold unless the egg is fertilized.

Name: THWOMP
Short Description: A giant angry rectangular boulder creature that moves in straight lines. Really likes crushing things below it. Summon as a hazard or a wall. Repairs itself when desummoned.

Name: Carpenter Ants
Short Description: A massive ant colony of literal carpenter ants. When provided with proper materials, they can build a house in a single day and expand by recycling wood waste. Might even build a town in a day when big enough.

Name: Shitty Copper
Short Description: A bag of endless shitty copper. Contains 1000 tons at a time.

Name: Perfect Decoy
Short Description: An exact replica of your body. Has no DNA or genetics. It's just a flesh puppet that looks exactly like you.

Name: Hormone Cookies
Short Description: 10 boxes of 20 pink strawberry wafer cookies each. Eating one cookie swaps your sex for 24 hours. Eating 20 in one day makes it permanent.

Name: Saw Cleaver
Short Description: Both a serrated saw and a massive cleaver. Great at slaying beasts. Extra damage against beasts and beastlike enemies.

Name: Music Player
Short Description: An indestructible MP3 player with great sound quality. Plays any song you've heard of before and records automatically.

Name: Psychic Paper
Short Description: A piece of paper that makes anyone who looks at it see what they expect or want to see, such as ID, permits, badges, etc. Doesn't work on smart people, people with no imagination, or anyone far more powerful than you.

Name: Doctor's Appointment Ticket
Short Description: Rip the ticket to receive a detailed doctor's note about your physical condition, plus several possible treatment plans for any conditions you might have.

Name: Escape Ticket
Short Description: Tear the ticket to teleport to a 4 cubic meter bunker in another dimension for 8 hours. The bunker is fully stocked with water and MREs and resembles a prison cell. You can be tracked by spatial manipulation abilities. You cannot escape without spatial manipulation. Teleports you back after 8 hours.

Name: Gun Voucher
Short Description: Tear the ticket to receive a real life (2026 or prior) gun of your choice. You receive one magazine for that weapon every 24 hours.

Name: Mystic Eye Killers
Short Description: A pair of stylish glasses that suppress eye based abilities and magic. Makes the user resilient to eye based abilities as well. Doesn't work if the ability is too powerful.

Name: Gosha Village
Short Description: Somewhere in your world, probably Japan or the closest analogue, is a secret ninja academy/headquarters of the Taimanin, demon slaying ninjas. Most of them are women, and all of them dress in really sexy latex suits. Also, there's a lot of horny demons now. Good luck with that.

Name: Invitation to The Gesellschaft
Short Description: Administrator [Naive Faust] cordially invites you to join The Gesellschaft, a space for Fausts to share knowledge and compile it together to know it all. Benefits from joining The Gesellschaft inclde: Becoming a Faust, getting to discuss and learn many things from other Fausts and much more (also Naive Faust can have someone else to chat to). If you deny this invitation you it will let you reroll again but Administrator [Naive Faust] will be sad.

Name: Snaust
Short Description: Snaust is a strange small snail-like being with a human head that resembles Faust. She may not be the smartest, but Snaust likes learning about many things, she also likes reading (and people reading things to her), sweets, and fruits.

Name: Propeller Hat with a Large Lollipop
Short Description: A propeller hat and a large rainbow lollipop of your favorite flavor. Putting on the hat and licking the candy will result in you regaining whimsy and remembering that the world is a kind place and everything can always get better.

Name: Deep Pockets
Short Description: From now on, all your pockets, bags or objects that are meant to hold something will have a larger space than what they should realistically be capable of without encumbering you. The space inside each will become larger the higher your base stats get.

Name: Okami Bestiary
Short Description: Almost a curse, but not quite- pollution and negativity in your world now form into thematically appropriate demons straight from Okami and Japanese myth. Defeat them and their boss monsters in the area and regrow guardian saplings to purify the area and return both life and peace to the land.

Name: NSOLA Company
Short Description: Somewhere in your world is a largely defunct company that specializes in creating mass produced sex bots either modeled after attractive celebrities, or left faceless and visibly robotic. Also, there are a lot of security bots, some of which have titties too. Take control and reactivate the facility to gain an army of big titty thicc bootied robot women.

Name: Mareth
Short Description: Somewhere in your world there is a village named Ingnam, near which is a portal to the Demon Realm of Mareth- a world of corruption, lust, sex, mutation, magic, violence, and conflict. Entering is easy. Leaving is nearly impossible. Beware how long you stay. You may not want to return anyway.

Name: Savarra
Short Description: Somewhere in your world is a gateway to the world of Savarra- a whole plane and world of its own with empires, magic, gods, corruption, and marauding demons from Mareth- and all worlds connected to it. Take care how long you stay- you might not want to come back, even if given the chance.

Name: United Galactic Confederacy
Short Description: Your world is now just one new planet within the entire United Galactic Confederacy- though you don't exactly know it yet. Once you or your civilization reach the level of space travel, the entire galaxy and all its wonders, drugs, sex, weirdness, mutations, corruption, and weird mutant corruption sex drugs are at your fingertips.

Name: H-Hell
Short Description: Hell is real, and it is horny as FUCK. It's still a demon invasion, but at least you get to fuck them instead of just getting ripped to pieces or tortured for eternity, right?

Name: Alfheim
Series: Youkoso! Sukebe Elf no Mori e
Short Description: Your world now has a hidden portal to Alfheim, a mystical forested land comprising only elves and dark elves, all of whom worship their great Holy Tree, which births new elves. Its power has been fading, though- either fix the tree's magic, or fuck every elf you see to repopulate the elven race and save them from extinction.

Name: Bundle of Minecraft Food and Seeds
Short Description: A green leather bundle that contains one of each food, seed, plant and sapling in Minecraft. Their growth speed is the same in game, taking less than a week to fully grow (less if you are using compost/fertilizer or Bone meal), and guarantees you will always get more of it when you harvest.

Name: Dark Mother
Short Description: The evil organization Dark Mother appears in your world, ruled by the mysterious (and always lactating) Phantom Lady and her many sexy female minions and generals! Their goals are mysterious, evil, and usually involve a lot of women getting sexually assaulted. Fighting them as well are the Angels! Angel Blade, Angel Ender, and Angel Beretta, the mostly naked (extremely lesbian) heroines of justice, love, and flashing their holes for literally everyone to see! Pick a side and fight for the fate of the world! Or just one city's sexually attractive female population.

Name: Anthro World
Short Description: Every human or sapient being in the world is now a thematically appropriate, usually quite sexually attractive and horny, anthropomorphic animal. Usually their own fursona, unless they didn't have one. The world is also way more sexually charged and open to public kink and sex as a result. You are the only one aware of the change. Try not to think too hard about the difference between an anthro cow lady and the beef at the supermarket.

Name: Guardian Saplings
Short Description: Every time you purge a place of unholy, dark, evil, or negative entities, you receive one Guardian Sapling. Plant it and allow it space to grow, and it will prevent further incursions from such entities. It even clears up pollution and sickness.

Name: Deckbuilder
Short Description: All of your gacha tickets now take the form of playing cards shuffled in random order at the start of each combat, allowing you to use ability combos faster and more easily than before, at the cost of randomness in your draw pattern. Standard deckbuilder rules apply during combat- discard pile, graveyard, draw pile, etc. The more tickets you get, the more cards you can play.

Name: Saibamen Pods
Short Description: A tube of Saibamen pods. When grown in high quality soil, they become far more powerful, even enough to rival beings capable of blowing up planets. These ones are modified to be slightly more intelligent and less likely to attack those that grow them.

Name: Monster Spawner
Short Description: A 1 cubic meter metal cage with faces decorating all six sides. When some kind of egg, juvenile, or other small creature is placed within, the spawner will light up with flames and begin creating fully grown duplicates of that creature en masse. Creatures must be less than 6x the size of the user. Once placed, it cannot be moved again. Killed duplicate creatures drop "XP" orbs that slowly rank up your stats as well as appropriate items for their type, ie sheep drop mutton and wool, cows drop beef, zombies drop rotten flesh, etc.

Name: Tech Tree: Gemtech
Short Description: You can now recreate and, eventually, improve upon the technology of the Gem Empire provided you have the tools and materials. Ships, warp pads, buildings, weapons, etc.

Name: Diamond
Short Description: You are now a big, lesbian, probably gigantic rock with a hardlight body and all the challenges that come from being 20+ feet tall in a world of humans. At least you can sing, dance, and have demigod-like powers. Pick a color, try to be original about your Diamond powers.

Name: Tech Tree: Spiral
Short Description: You can recreate the technology of the spiral races- Gunmen of all sizes, city ships, moon sized robots capable of FTL, ships that can target the universe itself. Grants a spark of Spiral Energy. Cultivate it well, or you won't get anywhere. Your starting point is a single handheld digging drill, once used by a little boy in a hole.

Name: GTFO
Short Description: You are smart enough to know when you're not built for a situation, and when your plot armor is paper thin. You have an easier time running from fights.

Name: Me and My Crew
Short Description: In any situation in which you are outnumbered you may call for your crew. Upon doing so a number of generic thugs, themed after yourself and fitting your preferences, will step out of any available cover until you now outnumber your enemy. These crew members have no special powers, but scale between half to three quarters of your own physical ability. They may carry simple melee weapons, which they can use to similar scaling to your own skill.

Name: 1v1 Me
Short Description: One single opponent and yourself are sent to an alternate dimension completely separate and unassailable from the outside. Once there you will continue whatever challenge is happening completely free of any interference. The dimension will supply all necessary objects, but these objects cannot be removed from the area. Bar completed products, should they need to be judged by a separate party as part of the challenge.

Name: Bakudan Transformation
Short Description: This allows you to transform into a Bakudan. Short, stubby legs, horns shaped like hooks, and the ability to create balls of explosives, these little guys pack a mean punch, but not much else. It'll take a lot of creativity to make good use of this form.

Name: Signature Weapon
Short Description: You have a signature weapon! This weapon can be anything you want, from a pair of knuckle dusters to an orbital kill sat, and everybody knows its yours. If it shows up, everybody will be convinced that you had a hand in it, regardless of the truth. You innately know how to make it, repair it, and care for it. It isn't immune to being destroyed, but you will quickly find yourself obtaining just enough resources to remake it and are incapable of using those resources for anything else.

Name: Krock Transformation
Short Description: This allows you to transform into a Krock, an armored lizard creature that can roll itself into a spiked ball to gain momentum. This momentum can build up hard enough to strike through walls, and if you can find yourself on two rails, you can increase your speed even further. Very defensive, but the offense is lacking.

Name: No Kings, No Gods, No Masters
Short Description: You cannot be held to any agreement, bound in any manner, or otherwise be forced to accept the words or actions of another. This doesn't prevent you from getting harmed or temporarily imprisoned, but you'll always get out eventually. Even the one true God couldn't keep you trapped or force you to do anything. You can still sign contracts, they just don't mean anything to you.

Name: Videogame Healing
Short Description: Allows you to eat food to actively heal your body from any damage you've taken. Doesn't fix limbs, but does fix stabs or blunt force trauma.

Name: Shaman
Short Description: To be a Shaman requires many things, but the most important of all is Furyoku. Through Furyoku, you may follow at least one of the Schools of Shaman training, gaining the ability to commune with long dead spirits as the bridge between the human world, and the world of Gods and Spirits. Oversouls, Shikigami, Necromancy, Witch arts. These and more are all possible.

Name: Inkling/Octoling
Short Description: You are now entirely composed of ink. Your base form is that of a squid or octopus, but you can transform into a humanoid form. Naturally generate ink, which is venomous, and can be used to paint things or create objects and weapons with training. You can fit through incredibly small spaces and submerge yourself in ink, which significantly increases your natural ink generation and rapidly heals you. Falling into enough water will kill you, anything pool sized or larger.

Name: Rave Blooded
Short Description: All of your bodily fluids are now neon colored, UV reactive, and glow in the dark. This has no effect on your health or biology beyond the cosmetic. You may chose colors when you roll this, but the choice is permanent.

Name: A Magic Top Hat
Short Description: A magical top hand. When you reach your hand inside you can pull out anyone or anything you know the exact location of, so long as it isn't too large. This does not give you the strength to actually pull them through the hat, just the opportunity.

Name: Blue Noah
Short Description: A 450m long flagship and migratory spaceship with a full complement of weaponry, fighters, and other resources needed to fly a long expedition. Resides in a pocket space until removed, at which point it can no longer be recalled. Being removed on a planet will put it in a safe orbit above such planet and place a landing craft in the nearest free space that can auto pilot you into the ship.

Name: Love Conquers All
Short Description: The more intense the bond of trust, friendship, and love between you and your companions, the stronger you both are. Starts small, but can achieve the impossible so long as you believe you can do so. Also makes you capable of concieving children together, regardless of potential impossiblity.

Name: The Penetrator
Short Description: An exceptionally large dildo with a handle. Useful as a baseball bat. It wiggles menacingly.

Name: Junko Enoshima
Short Description: The Ultimate Despair. An extremely perceptive and intelligent teenager capable of enacting an apoctalyptic scenario with nothing but the two aforementioned skills. Consistently bored with people, being capable of figuring out how someone will react in most any circumstance- bar when in despair. Completely fetishizes the emotion as a result, both wanting to feel it and have others feel it. To the point of self-sabotage. Otherwise often switches her personaliy and presentation as the mood suits her and she gets bored with her current one. Will react positively to being told how she died in her world.

Name: Tech Tree: Minecraft Create
Short Description: Gain access to the tech tree as given in the "Create" mod. Including all add-ons, such as aeronautics, estrogen, and etc. Automatically comes with a wrench, a set of cog wheels, some casings, and some shafts.

Name: Tech Tree: The Hunter's Workshop
Short Description: Beasts are for hunting, and now you have the tech to do it. Gain access to the technology and inventions of the Hunter's Workship, primarily featuring trick weapons. Uses a lot of blood and equally allows refining your own blood into an injected regenerative supplement.

Name: Gravity Falls Anomalies
Short Description: The world is now a much more interesting place. No matter where you are, legends, rumors, and other oddities will exist. Some are fake, but a lot more are real. Be careful, and never trust a triangle.

Name: White Monster Seeds
Short Description: A few curious seeds that, when planted, will grow into a single can of white Monster. Altering the seeds will make other types of Monster grow. More seeds can be obtained by letting the Monster grown by this seed bloom.

Name: Neti Transformation
Short Description: Become as tree. The Neti are a species of shapeshifting sentient plants that by default look like trees. You may survive through photosynthesis and water and can alter your size and shape at will, though you will always have bark for skin and a number of thin, branching arms. Lifespan is measured in thousands of years. You are Force Sensitive, and can train this into abilities such as mind reading, emotion reading, seeing the future (immediate or long term), manipulating or pushing things from a distance, and more.

Name: Neko Arc Transformation
Short Description: You are now a short catgirl creature. As a comedic character, you are nearly indestructible and possess a wide range of powers including eye beams and fire breathing. Your voice is also squeaky and you have an irresistible urge to add 'nya' into your speech. As a bonus, the cafe Ahnenerbe will appear in the world, a place where parallel worlds converge. It's strawberry pie is considered unmatched.

Name: Affini
Short Description: You become an Affini, a biologically immortal alien plant being with some shapeshifting capability and incredibly enhanced multitasking. Also you can graft any plant to your body and synthesize drugs within your tissues as well. Increases compassion and desire to tentacle-fuck a drugged up transgender puppygirl. No, that is not a joke.

Name: Lens of Truth
Short Description: A magical artifact resembling a purple magnifying glass with three prongs along the top, the Lens of Truth will allow the user to see perfectly through all illusions and reveal the invisible. Using the Lens will slowly drain energy.

Name: Gerudo Mask
Short Description: A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Gerudo warrior. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Gerudo, an all female race of exceptionally tall amazons. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

Name: Goron Mask
Short Description: A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Goron. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Goron, a race of strong and friendly rock eaters. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

Name: Zora Mask
Short Description: A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Zora. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Zora, an amphibious race of fish people. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

Name: Rito Mask
Short Description: A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Rito. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Rito, a race of flying bird people. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

Name: Deku Mask
Short Description: A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Deku Scrub. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Deku Scrub, a small humanoid plant able to spit nuts from their mouth. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

Name: Pacifier of Serentiy
Short Description: A plastic pacifier sized for an adult. When suckled upon, it will cause a calming feeling of mindless serenity to infuse the user, dispelling all fears and anxieties.

Name: Four Sword
Short Description: A magic sword, that when drawn will split the wielder into four aspects of themselves. The aspects can act independently, but still maintain the goals and drives as the original. The aspects can fuse back together by all sheathing the sword.

Name: Slime Core
Short Description: Generate a Slime Core, the central (and only) organ of a slime. Your body melts, turning entirely into slime. You may choose what color/s you have as well as whether or not you have simple patterns. Gain the ability to alter your entire body and grow bigger when intaking water. So long as your core is not damaged, you cannot be injured by anything which targets your physical body. The interior of your body is highly acidic, though you can turn that off, and you can consume anything. Also you're biologically immortal, don't need to breathe, and float on water.

Name: Vorpan
Short Description: An unbreakable frying pan. Still a good cooking utensil. Hits really hard.

Name: Feline Attachment
Short Description: A cat tail buttplug. When worn properly, increases reflexes, agility, dexterity, and acrobatics. Reduces fall damage. Use lube.

Name: Prayer Beads
Short Description: These Prayer Beads signify your devotion, granting you increased holy power, and even an adjustment to your temper. You could reach Nirvana, provided you channeled your chakras to the right place, and yanked them out like you were ripstarting a lawn mower.

Name: Blessed Peach Tree
Short Description: A magic peach tree. Every part of it is warded against evil, curses, and demons. A sword made from its wood could kill a ghost or a demon like steel through flesh. You receive one tree and 5 saplings.

Name: Beginner Shooting
Short Description: You shoot guns as good as the average soldier. You improve faster with training, though.

Name: Beginner Physics
Short Description: You can do physics as well as a physics grad student. Mostly good for lab work.

Name: Beginner Management
Short Description: You can manage your time and schedule enough that you could get a job as a secretary.

Name: Nimble
Short Description: You have moderately increased reflexes and speed

Name: Free Flier
Short Description: Flying becomes instinctual. Flying abilities are more efficient. Does not actually grant flight. Sorry.

Name: Charming Eyes
Short Description: Your eyes are now very, very pretty. Does not actually make them magical.

Name: Chill
Short Description: Create and control ice with enough precision to make ice cubes or ice knives.

Name: Illumination
Short Description: Conjure and control multiple bright light points. Consume more energy to make the lights semi-permanent

Name: Four Arms
Short Description: You now have four arms, obviously. You can control the new ones like you've always had them.

Name: Diagnosis
Short Description: Receive detailed information about a target on touch

Name: Slippery Skin
Short Description: You have abnormally slippery skin, like you're constantly coated in oil without being oily. Makes you hard to grab.

Name: Frisking Glance
Short Description: Anyone you look at, you know their full inventory, what they're wearing, and what's on their body. Also, you know the approximate value of each item.

Name: Dream Mirror
Short Description: View the dreams of anyone in your sensory range. You can influence them by whispering in their ears.

Name: Harvest's Bounty
Short Description: Create delicious fruits, vegetables, and other harvestable crops by spending energy

Name: Tech Tree: Mundane Vehicles
Short Description: You can make, modify, and design any mundane level of vehicle at current world's tech progression

Name: Hustle
Short Description: Perform a gesture or action lasting longer than half a second to recover energy and stamina. Can only be done in combat. The longer the action, the better the results. Aggravation equals effectiveness.

Name: Moonless
Short Description: A massive, mutated, four eyed wolf larger than a tank, capable of swallowing a grown man in one bite.

Name: Schrodinger's Cat
Short Description: A cat that teleports freely and cannot stay dead. Like the nazi catboy, but less problematic. And less useful.

Name: Dogmeat
Short Description: A seemingly immortal Dog that appears all around Post Apocalypse America, Dogmeat is a German Shephard, a very loyal friend, and a very good boy. Treat him well.

Name: Cathyl
Short Description: A minotaur lady with huge tits, big biceps, and a 7'7" tall frame. She's ridiculously strong, resistant to moderate heat, and lactates a lot. She's quite emotional and bad with names.

Name: Insti-gator
Short Description: An alligator specialized in provocation and starting conflicts. Really good at enraging entire crowds with words alone.

Name: Coco Jumbo
Short Description: An otherwise normal tortoise with the Stand "Mr. President", allowing anyone to access a room inside its shell with the right key. The room is pre-furnished and has a functional living space, but you must bring in your own food and equipment.

Name: Butcher's Bag of Infinite Meat
Short Description: A bag of effectively endless fresh meat. You can take 100kg of any normal animal meat from the bag every 24 hours. Reach inside and grab it. Try not to think of where it comes from.

Name: Magic Scroll of Blizzard
Short Description: Invoke the scroll to call a 1km wide blizzard centered on you. Lasts 30 minutes. Does not affect you or allies.

Name: Liquor Spring
Short Description: An ornate fountain/spring that flows perpetually. Any water taken from the spring turns into a high quality liquor of your choice after 1 hour. Returning the booze to the fountain resets it to water again.

Name: Blue Moon
Short Description: Retrieved from the Dungeon after the defeat of the Guardian, this Flail can extend far further then it should, and hits quite hard, hard enough to dent metal, crush stone, and shatter metal. Used correctly, it could be a powerful tool, but used incorrectly, and it's you who shall be the fool.

Name: Tozama
Short Description: Tozama, or Slaughter Demon, is a Cursed Tool, containing enough Cursed Energy that even a non-Jujutsu Sorcerer could use it to Exorcise a Cursed Spirit. Though basic, it is a reasonably useful weapon, both for a novice or a skilled wielder.

Name: Threaded Cane
Short Description: One of the Trick Weapons of the Hunter's Workshop, used to fulfil a Hunter's duties. It can stay locked together as a rigid bladed cane, or seperate into a whip covered in serrated blades. You could keep it untransformed, and simply flog your enemies to death in an act of ceremony. But finery must not be kept in place of survival.

Name: Speed Cola
Short Description: A can of soda that increases dexterity for one hour. Does not stack. You must drink the whole can. Do not drink more than 3 different buffing drinks at once. You will die.

Name: Skippy
Short Description: A smart automatic handgun capable of firing homing shots. Also comes with an onboard AI that can and will judge you. He's a bit annoying, but means well. 5 magazines to start.

Name: Earring of Hearing
Short Description: Clip on earrings that boost hearing to the level of a barn owl

Name: Nichirin Ingots
Short Description: 3 ingots, 5kg each. Nichirin has absorbed sunlight and is super effective against all things weak to the sun. Amplifies heat and fire based abilities. Can be superheated without deforming.

Name: Cipher Pata
Short Description: A pair of wrist mounted blades made entirely of ciphers of light. Scales with maximum energy level. Unblockable by physical objects. Deals holy damage.

Name: Beginner Blacksmithing
Short Description: You can make any basic weapon and tool in a forge (with dubious quality). You can accurately gauge the quality of any metalwork you have in person.

Name: Stylist
Short Description: You're a damn good hairstylist, enough to get a job working for celebrities and the 1%. It's second nature at this point.

Name: Durable
Short Description: Passively increases all physical defenses slightly

Name: Chronolog
Short Description: You have a perfect internal clock down to the millisecond with perfect timing and memory for dates.

Name: Flexible
Short Description: You are more flexible than an expert contortionist.

Name: Heat Object
Short Description: Heat up any object by touching it. The more energy you put in, the faster it heats up, and the more it heats up.

Name: Sand Veil
Short Description: Create a sandstorm around yourself that hides your location and presence. You can see out of it fine.

Name: Shadow Dart
Short Description: Create and fire silent shadow darts with bullet-like force

Name: Flash Grenade
Short Description: Create balls of light that act as flashbangs. Extra painful for dark-aligned enemies

Name: Blood Manipulation
Short Description: Ultra fine control over your own blood- pressurized bursts, guided arrows, knives, bullets, etc. You can only create more blood by having a physiology that converts energy to blood. Be careful not to die of blood loss.

Name: Super Jump
Short Description: Jump super high and super far at will. Leap tall buildings and such. You are also passively immune to fall damage.

Name: Route
Short Description: If you know the location or address of where you want to go, you can see a line guiding you there

Name: Stone Skin
Short Description: Cover your skin in a stone-like layer to increase durability and mass

Name: Tech Tree: Basic Augments
Short Description: Design, modify, and create technology based around augments and implants. At this level, you're limited mostly to medical grade implants at best.

Name: Tech Tree: Basic Defense
Short Description: Design, modify, and create technology based around physical defenses and shields. At this level, you're limited mostly to mundane barriers and bulletproof glass at best.

Name: Truth Assertion
Short Description: Allows you to make others think what you're saying is true. While active, you also cannot speak with intent to lie or deceive. Manifests as a glowing white choker.

Name: Anchor Point
Short Description: Put a mark at your feet. While the mark is active, you can teleport back to that mark anytime. The further you go, the more energy it takes. Only one at a time.

Name: Trial
Short Description: View people in grayscale according to your morality- the darker the shade, the less moral they are by your own reckoning.

Name: Condor Candle
Short Description: Expend health and energy to remotely detonate your blood into a conflagration. More vitality means more fire and force.

Name: Deathclaw Pair
Short Description: A pair of Alpha Deathclaws that, somehow, listen to you. They are a breeding pair. They're also incredibly strong and absorb radiation.

Name: Clothes Melting Slime
Short Description: A gray slime creature that melts all things referred to as clothes. The more clothes melted, the stronger it gets. The Apex Predator of all clothing.

Name: Yes Man
Short Description: A reprogrammed Securitron capable of interfacing with tech and writing code. Armed with its own guns. Incapable of telling you no.

Name: Connor
Short Description: An android sent by Cyberlife. Strong, competent, really good at detective work, odd habit of licking things. May go rogue when under high stress.

Name: B-2 Super Battle Droids
Short Description: The workhorse of the Clone Wars. Big, heavy, huge, strong, deadly. Armed with wrist blasters on both forearms. Start with 4, summon more as time goes on.

Name: Junimo
Short Description: The apple shaped keepers of the forest. Supernaturally good at maintaining wilderness, forests, and farms. Start with 50, increases over time.

Name: Wardrobe of Mending
Short Description: A wardrobe of fancy clothes that suit your tastes. Mends clothes automatically when not worn for 24 hours.

Name: Pitcher of Eternal Water
Short Description: A pitcher that can pour out an endless amount of clean drinking water.

Name: Fairy Powder
Short Description: Inhale the powder to instantly be put into a deep sleep. Injury wakes the inhaler up instantly. Does not work on stronger foes.

Name: Durable Baseball Bat
Short Description: It'd take a nuke to deform this baseball bat.

Name: Costume Wardrobe
Short Description: An infinite wardrobe full of any normal clothes you desire. Nothing too expensive or heavy, sorry! 50 outfits can be removed per day.

Name: Justice's Shades
Short Description: Really cool shades that detect when someone believes they're lying to you.

Name: Stamin-Up
Short Description: A can of soda that increases stamina for one hour. Tastes really sour. Does not stack. You must drink the whole can. Do not drink more than 3 different buffing drinks at once. You will die.

Name: Falcon's Eye
Short Description: A Shen Gong Wu monocle shaped like a falcon's head. Grants super vision: X-ray, far sight, and dark sight all at once.

Name: Chekov's Gun
Short Description: An M1 Garand that always shows up right when you need it and it ends up being useful. Can be modified without losing properties. Always shows up pristine and fully loaded.

Name: Hawk Glasses
Short Description: Regular glasses that grant the metaphorical visual acuity of a hawk

Name: Hound Collar
Short Description: A red dog collar that enhances olfactory abilities to bloodhound-like levels

Name: Brace of Exploding Tags
Short Description: A leather pouch containing 50 explosive tags. Each one goes off like a hunk of C4, enough to bust through walls and injure or kill enemy combatants from up to 15 feet away. Imbue with energy, then throw or set on a surface and RUN. Can be remote detonated with practice.

Name: Black Bow of Pharis
Short Description: A bow once belonging to the Heroic Archer Pharis. Has a very long range, and slightly guides your own aim. Comes with 30 arrows.

Name: Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch
Short Description: O Lord, bless this thy hand grenade, that with it thou mayst blow thine enemies to bits, in thy mercy. Take out the Holy pin, count to three, then throw. Will snuff out thine foes who are naughty in God's sight with 1 kiloton of force.

Name: Gag of Silence
Short Description: A ball gag that silences all noises produced by the wearer. Good for spies and ninja. Still humiliating.

Name: Green Spandex
Short Description: A green spandex suit that harnesses the power of YOUTH! Proudly wear it to gain extra bonuses to physical training and stamina recovery.

Name: Physician's Ring
Short Description: A platinum ring with a pink diamond. Increases comprehension and dexterity in all medical matters.

Name: Youmu Konpaku Fumo
Short Description: Rub the fumo against a sword to bless it with sharpness and anti-spirit properties

Name: Fujiwara no Mokou Fumo
Short Description: A fumo that never stays damaged, repairing itself instantly no matter what. Rub it against stuff to set that stuff on fire.

Name: Apprentice Driving
Short Description: You can drive anything with a fair amount of skill, from cars to planes to boats

Name: Beginner Teaching
Short Description: You just got your teaching degree! Good luck getting your students to engage.

Name: Beginner Polearm Mastery
Short Description: You can use any polearm with decent effectiveness, but anyone who knows how to fight with one will beat you

Name: Beginner Savoir Faire
Short Description: You're more graceful and know how to dance properly now. You can fall with grace and dignity.

Name: Mixology
Short Description: You're a damn good bartender and mixologist, good enough to get hired anywhere at a mundane level of skill. Still not as cool as that one japanese guy, though.

Name: Architecture
Short Description: You're damn good at architecture to the point of designing entire cities aesthetically. Engineers hate you.

Name: Kidnapping
Short Description: You're damn good at kidnapping people for... some... reason...?

Name: Strong
Short Description: You have slightly increased passive strength. Grows over time and applies to all strength buffs.

Name: Child Friendly
Short Description: The opposite of the NSFW tag. Keeps everything around you PG-13 and hides the worst of reality from sight. Mostly your junk.

Name: Paper Trail
Short Description: You always have your relevant papers and ID with you for whatever situation you're in. Extends to all allies when in the same group.

Name: Aesthetic Overlay
Short Description: Your transformations, race changes, and body changes all stay aesthetically pleasing. To you, at least.

Name: Introspection
Short Description: You always know your own condition, mentally and physically. Poison, depression, illness, injury, etc etc. You always know what's going on with you.

Name: Shoebody
Short Description: The great teachings of John the Boptist. You know the perfect way to headbutt someone, and your forehead is strengthened for that purpose. Shoebody BOP! Increases acapella skill for some reason.

Name: Electrician
Short Description: No, not the trade. You just get higher electrical resistance and higher electric ability efficiency

Name: I Can Quit Whenever I Want
Short Description: You are immune to getting addicted to any substance, no matter how much it affects your brain.

Name: Spine of Steel
Short Description: Your spine is abnormally durable and hard to injure. Even if completely shattered, your spine heals properly far faster than any normal human

Name: Poisonous
Short Description: Every part of you is poison- flesh, bones, blood, energy, soul. The potency depends on your own stats. You are, thankfully, immune to your own poison. You might need something to regulate all this at will.

Name: Adhesion
Short Description: You can be sticky enough to cling to walls or prevent people from unsticking themselves from you. You can control your own stickiness. You're still no Spider-Man though.

Name: Deadman
Short Description: Your body has been implanted with a Nameless Worm, transforming you into a Deadman. Your body has gained a 'Red Diamond' inside of it, and yve gained access to a Branch of Sin ability. What your ability manifests as will be random, and could be long range, close range, or even allow you to create Hexagonal Wires connected by Blood. You'll need to train to prevent Anemia, and may even be able to evolve your abilities to crush entire cities.

Name: Nullbulge
Short Description: A black sticky orb that when attached on someone's crotch, will cover either their body or underwear in a layer of the same colour, making the orb gain a customizable symbol and turning it into a really sensitive part of the body incapable of getting release. The orb can only be removed by the one that placed it in the first place.

Name: The Backrooms
Short Description: In your world there is an alternate dimension born from the cognition of all living beings, resembling more a desolate office space with half-working ceiling lights and half-wet carpet floor that smells of almond. The only way to enter here is by 'No-clipping' on a random space in the world, you will neither suffer hunger nor thirst, but returning will be a challenge on itself.

Name: Find my Pages
Short Description: Now in a forest in the world, resides the Slenderman and its pages. Anyone unfortunate to enter the forest and grab one of the pages will incur its wrath. If you find all of its pages without dying, it will occasionally aid you at odd times.

Name: Juggernog
Short Description: A can of cola that increases resilience for one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Double Tap Root Beer
Short Description: Root beer that somehow increases fire rate for one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: PhD Flopper
Short Description: Everybody do the flop! Grants immunity to explosions and fall damage for one hour. When you drop to the ground from a small height, makes you explode and harm everyone around you. Tastes like prunes and chemicals. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Deadshot Daiquiri
Short Description: When attack, you will always naturally aim for the head for one hour. Tastes sweet, like strawberries. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Mule Kick
Short Description: Somehow allows you to carry one more weapon than you normally could without issue for one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Tombstone Soda
Short Description: For one hour, if you are severely injured or killed, you will not lose anything you would normally have lost as a result. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Double Tap Root Beer II
Short Description: For one hour weapons shoot or arm faster and each bullet inexplicably becomes two at no cost. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Who's Who
Short Description: For one hour, if you are injured to the point of unconciousness or killed, a doppelganger will spawn. You control the doppelganger, who only has a pistol and clothes, and if you get back to your body you may revive yourself, keeping everything but this perk. The doppelganger spawns near, but not in sight of, your body. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Electric Cherry
Short Description: Reloading any weapon causes a small shockwave centered on yourself for one hour. This shockwave stuns anyone too close to you. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Vulture Aid Elixir
Short Description: For a single hour, you may see anything helpful to you through walls, such as unusued weapons. In addition, you have a much higher chance to somehow obtain ammo for your weapons or money from defeated foes. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Widow Wine
Short Description: If you're hit, an explosion of webbing will occur that binds anyone near you. Further, any explosives you use also send out these webs in addition to their usual effects and melee weapons will equally bind foes. This effect lasts one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Perkaholics Anonymous
Short Description: Perks just keep coming... you may activate the effects of any perk soda at will for the standard hour, with a cooldown of four hours after use. Further, you may drink any number of perk sodas, or activate any number of their effects, at one time without suffering any negative effects.

Name: The Thievius Raccoonus
Short Description: An ancient family tome passed down through history, the Thievius Raccoonus has been filled out by generation after generation of the Cooper Clan. With this book, you can learn the skills of a master thief, and eventually see the blue sparks. Remember to jump and hit the Circle button.

Name: A Case of RC Cola
Short Description: A four pack of ice cold Royal Crown Draft Cola in glass bottles. Kind of a dud, but it tastes nice.

Name: Boss Monster
Short Description: You're bigger. You're stronger. You're more resilient. You have a health bar constantly visibly to anyone that tries to fight you. You have a theme song that plays whenever you fight. You can use fog to block and area and force anyone entering to confront you. You're the fucking boss, and nobody is going to forget it.

Name: Apotheosis
Short Description: You're a god. Not metaphorically or anything- legitimately a god. Choose something, you're in charge of it. Choose a couple more things if you want. You aren't in charge of them, but you can still do some stuff with it. Be careful- you can still die, and the games gods play are always the most dangerous.

Name: Aperture Science
Short Description: Under a wheat field and an outhouse lies the abandoned and partially destroyed main HQ of Aperture Science, overseen by GLaDOS. Should you find yourself here and complete the tests you'll find the documents necessary to declare yourself the CEO and sole owner of the entire company. The company maintains its excellent, if insane, reputation.

Name: Fazbear Entertainment
Short Description: A Utah based megacorporation reponsible for many extreme advances in robotics and artificial intelligence, all driven into attempting to making chain mascot resaurants. They own their entire supply chain, from the restaurants to the contruction companies to the mining companies. Currently overseen by a board of directors infected by the Mimic- a hostile memetic/roboic entity based on child murderer WIlliam Afton. Solving the mysteries of the various murders and haunting of the company will grant you documents allowing you to take control of the entire company. Provided you have any ability at seeing into Hell, you can find William Afton himself, if you want to stab him or something.

Name: Bat Shark Repellant
Short Description: It repels sharks. That's it.

Name: Dryleaf Arts
Short Description: The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey. You now know both the common version of the art and the version used by Dryleaf Dane.

Name: Emu
Short Description: A normal Australian emu with intelligence close to that of a human. You may choose the sex.

Name: Pigeon
Short Description: A normal pidgeon with intelligence close to that of a human. You may choose the sex.

Name: Sentient Battleform
Short Description: Cast and cry, cast and cry~ You are now a Sentient battle form, ranging anywhere from the size of a large dog to almost 20 feet tall. You can fly, are an inhumanly shaped mass of robotics with a central core, have cool glowy bits, energy projectiles, and probably a laser beam. Also, you can hack into just about any tech you find.

Name: Hercules Gene/MSTN Gene (Myostatin)
Short Description: A mutation on both copies of the myostatin gene that removes limits on muscle mass. You have the idealized form of this, now getting larger and stronger muscles, and rapidly enhancing any gains from training. Just make sure to eat a lot of protein.

Name: Reverse Card
Short Description: A single use card that can reflect anything. Attacks, insults, debt, you name it!

Name: Ludicrous Speed
Short Description: Spaceball I's warp drive compressed into a pocket sized button! Guaranteed to get you anywhere you need to be before you need to be there! (Warning: Using this will cause you to go plaid and possibly slam into a wall when trying to slow down)

Name: Pokemon Egg
Short Description: Congratulations on starting your Pokemon Journey! Here's your complementary Egg! It will hatch anywhere from 5 to 120 days (depending on egg cycle) into a random non-Mythical/non-Legendary Stage 1 pokemon and will bond with whomever the owner of said egg is upon hatching. Roll a random number for your new companion!

Name: Random Technical Machine
Short Description: A one-time use disk that will teach the recipient one random Pokemon move from the list of available TM moves. As TM numbers shift between each generation, the generation this disk will draw from will be randomized.

Name: Codec System
Short Description: A special operations micro radio system that can transmit images and whole conversations in less than a second with the reciever manipulating the small bones in ear for an incoming call. Every restock grants an additional pair.

Name: Technical Machine Carry Case
Short Description: A storage container that creates one-time use disks that will teach the recipient the pokemon move it contains. These disks will be generated at a rate of 1 disk per 1 week and can be stored in the container for future use. Every disk's imprinted move is randomized on creation from the list of available TM moves. Roll a random number to decide the generation it draws from.

Name: Omnipotent Orb
Short Description: The Omnipotent Orb is an a sphere made of an unknown material that bends the laws of the universe to nullify damage from any and all attacks, physical or magical, with the sole exception of 'Almighty' attacks capable of erasing something from existence.

Name: Lucky Mallet
Short Description: This little mallet will slightly increase the strength, dexterity, vitality, agility and luck of whoever it hits.

Name: Friede's Great Scythe
Short Description: A large scythe that innately freezes an enemy on contact. Somehow always slashes the opponent no matter where they are struck with it, though more damage is done when the actual blade hits. By using a bit of energy a second, smaller, scythe may be summoned that inflicts magic damage. Together they are extremely aggressive and can send out sheets of ice that explode a second or two later.

Name: Tech Tree: Factorio
Short Description: FACTORY IS GOD. You gain knowledge of the entire tech tree of Factorio starting from Nauvis all the way to Space Age. Makes you violently murderous towards large bugs. The Factory Must Grow.

Name: Highlight
Short Description: Mark a target on touch. All highlighted targets have a colored outline you can see as long as they're within visible range, even through walls or while blind.

Name: Focused Strikes
Short Description: Mark a target within line of sight. All attacks while active will only deal damage to that target.

Name: Alcremie
Short Description: A dessert themed pokemon, sweet and cute. Comes in 9 cute varieties. Not always great at fighting, but she'll do her best! Extra damage against dragons due to Fairy typing

Name: Miriel the Pastor of Vows
Short Description: The steward of the Church of Vows. A gigantic tortoise wearing a large white mitre, Miriel is a gentle soul who will happily assist you on your journey. Miriel can be given scrolls as well as prayerbooks, and will readily teach new spells to the player for an appropriate fee. The best dog

Name: Bucky
Short Description: A headless chicken with a bowtie. Never stops joking around. As a Devil, he can form contracts with others and heal via blood. Not very strong, though, because people aren't afraid of chickens.

Name: Crate of Explosives
Short Description: A crate of prospector's TNT. Use it wisely, and don't let anyone think it's a weird candle brand.

Name: X-ray Goggles
Short Description: A pair of X-Ray goggles that do all that fun stuff you saw on TV. See through walls, see through clothes, see through things you really don't want to. Comes with a dial to adjust the depth.

Name: Long Lost Delivery
Short Description: A single use cell phone. Call the number within and describe your lost item. It will be delivered in less than a week.

Name: Horseshoe Necklace
Short Description: A horseshoe on a necklace that grants the leg strength and stamina of a well bred horse. Kimi no aiba ga~!

Name: Barrel of Everflowing Oil
Short Description: A 55 gallon drum containing an endless supply of medium quality crude oil. When tipped, oil pours at a steady 10 gallons per minute. Do not damage or modify the drum.

Name: Buffout
Short Description: A highly potent anabolic steroid, popularized during Pre-War America's hey-day by professional athletes, this drug will act incredibly quickly, granting you increased strength, reflexes, and endurance. Be careful, it's addictive.

Name: Claidheamh Mor
Short Description: Highlander rules. Take someone's head with this zweihander to steal their energy and strength to add to your own.

Name: Third Arm Sash
Short Description: A belt sash that acts as a third arm, the Third Arm Sash is an incredibly useful Shen Gong Wu that grants the user an item that acts as a grappling hook, a swing, or a third fist. It can be infused with elemental power, and when combined with several other Shen Gong Wu can become the great Heylin Demon Mala Mala Jong.

Name: Beginner Blade Weapon Mastery
Short Description: You're reasonably skilled at any bladed weapon you pick up. Not enough to win fights, but enough to actually use it.

Name: Beginner Charisma
Short Description: You're more charismatic now, more attractive, nothing fancy but you could probably get a couple thousand followers as an influencer.

Name: Aesthetic Grooming
Short Description: You're good at taking care of your hair, hygiene, cleanliness, etc. You always know how to be presentable

Name: Beginner Conceptualization
Short Description: You have an easier time comprehending and understanding mystical and esoteric forces, not much more than the average person though.

Name: Beginner Persuasion
Short Description: You are slightly better with your words, and could probably win an online argument with an intelligent opponent

Name: Farming
Short Description: You could actually run a farm without looking like an idiot, and could compete with fairly experienced farmers

Name: Mental Image Blocking
Short Description: Dude what the fuck are those Tibetan monks teaching people. You are not quite immune, but can fool most telepaths and mind readers with false images and memories

Name: Hygienic
Short Description: You are naturally hygenic, both intentionally or otherwise.

Name: Animal Lover
Short Description: All mundane animals adore you, and non-mundane ones will take a shine to you more easily

Name: Metabolism
Short Description: You can control your own metabolism at will, speeding it up or slowing it down to a crawl.

Name: Pretty Up
Short Description: Your looks have now all been enhanced. You're basically the prettiest version of you as you are now.

Name: Perfect Skin
Short Description: You always have pretty, perfect skin. No more scars or unwanted marks. Your skin and superficial injuries heal faster now too.

Name: Santa's Exception
Short Description: Much like Santa, people no longer mind you breaking into places you by all rights shouldn't be in. If you cause a disturbance or offend/frighten them in some way, that goes out the window. Followed by you, for your own safety.

Name: Geyser
Short Description: Create erupting geysers from the ground around you within 10 meters at base. The more power used, the stronger the geyser. Usually scalding hot by default.

Name: Impulse
Short Description: Enhance the speed of your nerve signals, increasing reflexes and speed. Overuse causes nerve damage, but training increases resistance to that nerve damage.

Name: Quicksand
Short Description: You can now turn the ground around you into quicksand at will to entrap enemies. Starts at 10 meters of range.

Name: Earth Armor
Short Description: Create earthen armor around your body to absorb physical attacks. Does not impede movement or speed. Might improve it, with practice.

Name: Razor Claws
Short Description: Turn your nails into razor claws that could tear through steel if you wanted to. They never dull, until you turn them back to normal.

Name: Tech Tree: Cosmetics
Short Description: Modify, create, and design anything related to cosmetics and appearance. Hyper-real masks, aesthetic designs for machines, holograms, beauty cream, perfumes, lipsticks, etc.

Name: False Data
Short Description: Feed enemies false data about your skills and abilities. Scrying and scanning type powers see what you want instead of what you have.

Name: Tech Tree: Real Robotics
Short Description: Design, modify, and build any real life examples of robotics- claw arms, Boston Dynamics stuff, automated drones, whatever. Has to be real life stuff, though.

Name: Ganta Gun
Short Description: A Branch of Sin that allows you to fire a condensed blood bullet at supersonic velocity. The more blood used and power expended, the stronger it gets.

Name: Touch Technopathy
Short Description: Manipulate any device like it's part of your own body just by maintaining physical contact with its surface

Name: Gama
Short Description: From your shadow or nearby shadows, summon up to 5 large frog shikigami capable of holding people in their mouths, ensnaring targets with their tongues, and throwing and lifting heavy objects with said tongues. Can be summoned at different sizes, and in different amounts based on energy spent and energy capacity.

Name: Orochi
Short Description: From your shadow or nearby shadows, summon a massive building sized serpent shikigami capable of grabbing and crushing enemies in its coils or mouth, as well as burrowing and traveling through shadows. Size can be adjusted based on energy capacity and expenditure.

Name: Stray Cat
Short Description: A very temperamental cat... plant... ghost... thing. In a pot. It controls air by creating deadly explosive bubbles that it freely directs. Each bubble can be used like real bullets or shields, or as carriers for any ability that "charges" an object with an effect. Gets sleepy in the dark. Premium fertilizer and cat treats only.

Name: Untitled Goose
Short Description: The biggest shithead asshole goose in existence. A bona fide expert in fucking with people and pissing them off. Cannot be permanently killed. Respawns after one hour. I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemies... but you might.

Name: Puss
Short Description: An anthropomorphic, spanish daredevil of an orange cat. Very cute, very skilled, very agile. Extremely good with a rapier and a knife. Has nine lives... but might waste them doing stupid shit for the crowd.

Name: Ring of Invisibility
Short Description: An ornate platinum ring that bends light around the wearer, rendering them invisible but NOT silent. Be careful when using it to sneak around. You are not immune to pressure plates or microphones.

Name: Reiterpallasch
Short Description: A weapon wielded by the Noble Knights of Cainhurst, this Rapier combined an Elegant Knight's Sword with the peculiar firearm wielded by the Cainhurst Order. Used for the disposal of Beasts and Men alike, this weapon transforms between a normal rapier, and a gun with a bayonet attachment.

Name: Malorian Overture
Short Description: A heavy duty double action semi auto revolver chambered in .42 caliber. Comes with glowing iron sights and 6 round capacity. Bullets naturally ricochet off of hard surfaces. 30 bullets a day, every day.

Name: Death Perception Soda
Short Description: A can of cola that allows you to see the outlines of enemies through walls and obstructions for one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Name: Homerun Bat
Short Description: A really durable baseball bat with extreme knockback on hit. Makes a really satisfying sound when it hits someone.

Name: 40k Warhammers
Short Description: Forty thousand standard iron warhammers kept in item storage. You can take them out one at a time.

Name: Demon Blood Blade
Short Description: One badass blade made from the blood of the demon Kee-Oth. Unholy in nature, deals increased damage to angelic and holy beings. Also hits spiritual entities. Responds very well to hemokinesis.

Name: Snake's Box
Short Description: A very unassuming box you can hide beneath and sneak with. Suppresses all presence while worn. Returns to item space on destruction. Can fool literally anything as long as they don't see you move.

Name: Jar Helmet
Short Description: A really cool pot worn as a helmet, once worn by a certain naked guy to fight a certain rot goddess. Grants increased physical capabilities and agility when facing divine entities and gods. Does not hinder vision. Supremely durable.

Name: Flintslate
Short Description: A tool made of polished flintgem, vaguely resembles a crystal with a metal handle. Sharpen any bladed weapon with the flintslate to imbue it with fire, causing it to deal extra damage and set enemies on fire for five minutes at a time. 3 uses per rest period.

Name: Mentats
Short Description: A miracle drug that enhances mental functions, granting clarity, processing speed, and memory retention. Also highly addictive. Overuse can cause severe memory degeneration and mental disorder. One box with eight doses.

Name: Reduvia
Short Description: A jagged, bloodstained, forever dripping, twisted dagger. Infuse the blood with energy to create a blood slash to hit enemies at range. Decreases the drain of vitality consuming effects.

Name: The Cursed Ticket
Short Description: Rip this ticket to roll the curse gacha! Any curse rolled automatically applies (sometimes retroactively), and also grants its standard ticket reward on application.

Name: Thalasin
Short Description: One box of prescription Thalasin, contains eight pills that chemically induce emotions regardless of biology and even powers through most resistances. Usually contains one of: Anger, Sadness, Happiness, Fear, Relief, Hope, Frustration, Pride, Lust, etc.

Name: Apprentice Blacksmithing
Short Description: You can forge decent quality armor, weapons, tools, and decorations with the right tools and equipment.

Name: Apprentice Teaching
Short Description: You can teach pretty well, anyone you try to instruct at anything will usually remember and internalize what you teach.

Name: Beginner Ninjutsu
Short Description: You have passed ninja basic training. You can handle knives and swords, and have a basic grasp of being a sneaky acrobatic ninja.

Name: Cat's Feet
Short Description: You always land on your feet and are completely immune to fall damage.

Name: Arousing Scent
Short Description: You smell REALLY good. To the point it makes anyone sniffing you kinda horny.

Name: Stonesprout
Short Description: This ability grants you the power to create constructs of rock and stone. Create walls, transform the terrain around you, smash your enemies with large pieces of rock, drive around on giant stone pillars. The possibilities aren't endless, but they are pretty varied.

Name: Crystals
Short Description: Generate Crystals from your body, letting them erupt out of you like spikes, or coating your skin for armor. You could sell them for crash, or refine the inner crystalline structure to form what you need with a keen eye.

Name: Low Gravity
Short Description: Lower the gravity of areas within your line of sight, reducing weight, falling speed, or inertia in some cases of objects you see.

Name: Catch the Rainbow
Short Description: Catch the Rainbow functions as an ability for you to utilize, allowing you to control the rain for many different effects, some useful in a fight, others useful for mobility. Although this ability is incredibly powerful, it has a single drawback. It must be utilized during rainfall. Not waterfall, not a sprinkler. It has to be rain. Step on raindrops, seperate pieces of your body after letting them be hit with rain, plug your wounds temporarily to allow you to fight on, create blades or 'shrapnel' by throwing raindrops. A creative user is required to take full advantage of this Stand.

Name: Sapling
Short Description: You can create and communicate with plants that you can manipulate within a general range of your body, around ten meters to start with. Make the grass grow, ripen plants or change their shape, create natural barriers of brambles or trees. All of this to harvest the bounty of nature.

Name: Web Slinger
Short Description: Look, we've all seen Sam Raimi's Spider-Man movies. Thwip Thiwip. It's just Tobey-Spidey's organic web shooters without the rest of the Spider-Man package. You gotta earn that.

Name: Piercing Eyes
Short Description: You can see far away, and see through objects. Better then 20/20 vision, you can also adjust the intensity of your new staring ability to suit your needs.

Name: Tech Tree: Basic Alchemy
Short Description: The bare bones basics of Alchemy. Make alembics, pestle and mortar, or anything else you need to make potions. Right now you can only make mild things, health potions, stamina potions, weak defense potions, and 'weak' acids that could still eat through armor or stone, but with practice you could make more.

Name: Elemental Sight
Short Description: You have become attuned to the Elemental Forces and Energies of the World. The currents of the air, the flame of heat, the lightning's tremor, the feel of the earth, and the flow of water. You can see it all in your line of sight by looking through everything else in the world. Extends further to the electricity in someone's brain, the water in their blood, the way electricity flows through cables.
