Magically charged elements are even more vibrant to represent their connection to that element.

Name: Barbs
Short Description: Your attacks now feel as if they're coated in barbed wire, leaving cuts wherever you hit proportional to the amount of damage that attack would normally inflict.

Name: Dash
Short Description: Allows you to perform a Dash, granting you increased mobility once you activate it and pick a direction. You can move in any direction using this ability, and it can be used in the air.

Name: Obsidian Gargoyles
Short Description: Obsidian Gargoyle Statues brought to life. These statues are deceptively fast as they soar through the air, with a durable body and strength to match their stone forms. Able to tear a man in half without issue and ignore most small arms, they're incredibly effective Soldiers. You get five Gargoyles to start with, and can gain more based on your personal strength.

Name: Hellhound
Short Description: A Hound of Hell in the flesh, this creature is as large as a human with a flaming, tooth filled maw that allows them to bellow out fire. If that isn't interesting enough, they have the strength to rip a grown man in half as well.

Name: Wraith
Short Description: A weaker Spirit, though stronger then a ghost, a Wraith has very little combat power, but is very difficult to detect. They would be incredibly effective at scouting and surveillance, and will reform if killed after a short period of time.

Name: Gathering Swarm
Short Description: Do you find yourself leaving a lot of money behind as you hurry along your way? Fret not, this swarm of Lightbugs will gather any loose change near you. Useful for those who can't bear to leave anything behind, no matter how insignificant.

Name: Ring of Swiftness
Short Description: A magical ring made of Silver, this Ring improves your agility, reflexes, and balance, and even acts as a training aid, making it easier to practice with those skills.

Name: Hideout Realtor
Short Description: Create a secret hideout wherever you choose and it shall appear, packed full of the essentials and only accessable by you through a door you have created.

Name: Hero's Bandages
Short Description: Bandages that automatically seek out your injuries and cover them, they're very effective at stopping you from bleeding, or setting your broken bones. You could eventually work to train them for other uses.

Name: Cheshire Cat's Ring
Short Description: A gold ring engraved with a suspiciously smug cat. When wearing this ring you will be immune to fall damage, even if you fell from orbit.

Name: Relic Gold
Short Description: A gold coin, anyone who sees it will suddenly decide they must have it, as they believe it to be incredibly valuable. You could trade it for something so precious it could be considered one of a kind, and the recipient would still consider it a good deal.

Name: Regalia
Short Description: A transforming car that can switch between a general daily driving luxury car, an All Terrain Vehicle monster truck, or even a jet that could fly across the world. Stylish, durable, and sure to get you to where you're going. Gas included, it will be restocked every eight hours. Runs on Jet Fuel.

Name: Perfume Pouch
Short Description: A pouch containing all the aromatic essentials from the Perfumers of the Lands Between. It contains an Acid Spraymist, a Poison Spraymist, a Bloodboil Aromatic, an ironjar Aromatic, and an Uplifting Aromatic. Restocks.

Name: Second Skin
Short Description: Skintight, so lightweight you won't even notice it on your body, it's like you're wearing nothing at all! The suit stimulates the body, drawing out its latent potential and improving your physical performance, although it has the unfortunate side effect of increasing and amplifying all sensations felt by the user. When worn with other clothing, it will suffer in efficiency. It is incredibly durable, tougher then steel, and will slowly mend over time.

Name: Apprentice Programming
Short Description: Grants you the knowledge of all Programmer Languages. Your efficiency and ability to code have improved dramatically, and you can generally read any programming language you encounter.

Name: Apprentice Blunt Weapon Mastery
Short Description: Your ability to handle blunt instruments and weapons such as hammers, mauls, clubs, or even rocks has been increased, you now know how to effectively move your body to take advantage of these weapons, and could match most practioners in skill and finesse.

Name: Apprentice Taming
Short Description: You have an increased affinity and ability to take most wild animals, making them subservient to you and obediant to your orders. You can also learn how to tame specific creatures faster, including humans to an extent.

Name: Beginner Item Construction
Short Description: You can now enchant items! To a small extent anyway. A plate that automatically heats itself, a rudimentary hotplate, a basic gas mask. So long as you know what you're doing, or know of the effect you wish to recreate, you could reasonably do so. Though stronger items may take more time.

Name: Apprentice Performance
Short Description: Sing a song, do a dance, play an instrument! You can do it all with this download of knowledge. You could even be the frontman to a band, if you wanted.

Name: Beginner Spycraft
Short Description: You're an okay spy. Not a great one, but okay. You can eavesdrop, mask feelings, deceive people, use disguises, and deduce plans. You're also okay with guns and knives. You're no match for a trained spy though.

Name: Silent Steps
Short Description: You naturally have silent footsteps, like an assassin. Or a cat.

Name: Breathless
Short Description: You no longer need to breathe at all, even in space. You can still act like it, though. Also you can speak even in a vacuum

Name: Poseidon's Blessing
Short Description: You can now breathe underwater, move just as well underwater as on land, and are friends to all natural sea life.

Name: Hacker
Short Description: You can intuitively find any fault and interface skillfully with technology. You have an increased ability to get around firewalls and other digital defenses.

Name: Iron Fist
Short Description: You have fists literally as hard as iron. Your unarmed strikes and fist abilities are enhanced.

Name: Fast Reflexes
Short Description: Your reflexes are fast enough to dodge normal punches and even avoid the aim of guns with ease. Scales with stats.

Name: Thick Skin
Short Description: Your skin is dense and strong enough to serve as tough padding or even armor, without losing its natural smooth texture and feel.

Name: Made Maid
Short Description: You may designate lower members of an orgnization you are part of, and yourself, as 'Made Maids'. So long as they continue to work for the organization they will gradually improve at 'maid' duties, including cooking, cleaning, fashion, repair, and combat. This process will also gradually feminize them- you may designate an 'ideal maid' which they will resemble when the process is finished. This also makes them much less likely to leave the organization without significant reason. As you get stronger, the affected will resemble the 'ideal maid' more and more, to the point where they will all eventually look exactly like it.

Name: Body Shifting Massage
Short Description: Gain skills in massaging around fat, bone structure, and the body in general. When performing a massage, you may alter the body of anyone you are working on into whatever shape you like through moving what they already have around. With practice you may add more, but by default it is sum zero. For instance, if you wish to give a man breasts the fat must come from somewhere else on the body. Slimming the waist means what was there must go somewhere else. The affected person will not realize what you are doing while on the table, but as soon as the massage is done nothing will prevent them from noticing.

Name: Skinsuit Zipper
Short Description: A simple zipper that, when applied to a person's skin, can be unzipped. This will instantly remove that person's ability to move and render their body completely empty. Anyone may then step into the body, regardless of how different their body is to the new suit, and zip the zipper to take control of that body. They gain access to all the memories and reflexes of the body they are inhabiting, and the original person in effect goes to sleep and 'dreams' whatever the person wearing their body does. People with strong wills can resist the zipper. The zipper may be removed by the one who placed it at any time, potentially locking someone into a body that isn't their own.

Name: Body Pump
Short Description: One bike pump. Serves as a normal bike pump, but can also be attached to any body part. When pumped, that part of the body will fill with air and get bigger. There is no limit to how large this can make a body part, and the enlarged part is oddly bouncy and light due to being filled with air. The part will lose air over time and return to its normal size.

Name: Progenitor of Monsters
Short Description: Your kids are monsters, literally. At any point you may decide to have a child, and any time you have sex you may decide to get pregnant or get your partner pregnant. This child is guaranteed to be a new species, with abilities, traits, looks, and similar determined by you maxing one value below the max value of of your stats. The only guarantee is that they are naturally considered scary, threatening, or monstrous by the inhabitants of the world, regardless of what they actually look like. The pregnancy is guaranteed to be fast, though stronger kids take more time. Delivery will not cause any complications.

Name: Pocket Stomach
