Short Description: Transmute any solid material you touch into any mundane gun, fully loaded. Potency of bullet scales with the material used.

Name: Conjure Bow and Arrow
Short Description: Create a bow and arrow with your own energy, works like a normal bow and arrow. The more energy you use, the more damaging the arrow.

Name: Iron Skin
Short Description: Reinforce your entire body to the point that it resembles metal more than flesh. Increases your mass as well while enhancing durability and lowering speed. Even a car crashing into your body would barely hurt you.

Name: Bat Form
Short Description: Transform into a bat or bat hybrid at will. Gain enhanced senses, sonar, flight, agility, claws, teeth, etc. Might cause extreme light sensitivity.

Name: Location Pin
Short Description: Mark any object or creature via touch, allowing you to monitor their physical condition and relative location to you. 10 marks to start with, though it increases with time and training.

Name: Minor Cure
Short Description: Heal others on touch by expending energy. Works for stabs, slashes, broken bones, etc. More severe wounds take more energy, stronger targets are harder to heal. Does not cure aging or status effects or genetic defects, just physical wounds.

Name: Speed Boost
Short Description: Increase the speed of all movements by spending energy. Reaction speed does not increase with your own speed. The faster you are, the more energy it takes.

Name: Rock Constructs
Short Description: Create and shape rock constructs within 20 meters of your body. You are not an Earth bender, so you don't get to control them after they're made. You can make weapons, obstructions, building blocks, etc.

Name: Grappling Vines
Short Description: Sprout and control supernaturally strong vines from your body capable of whipping, grappling, binding, etc. Higher energy means stronger, longer, and more durable vines. Also can sprout thorns if you want. All vines vanish once you deactivate the ability.

Name: Adventure Line
Short Description: A yellow line on the ground that leads you to an adventure if you choose to follow it. Ranges from finding a new good restaurant to stumbling on a murder scene and beyond. Guarantees an interesting day, if nothing else.

Name: Observer
Short Description: A set of 10 floating disembodied eyeballs capable of sending their sight to you and following complex commands. Any eye that dies can be resummoned within 24 hours. They have no combat power and are quite squishy.

Name: Griffon
Short Description: A standard griffon the size of an elephant- lion lower half, hawk upper half. Very vicious. Very loyal. You get one mating pair capable of breeding.

Name: Max Elephant
Short Description: From your shadow or nearby shadows, summon an elephant shikigami capable of conjuring and spewing massive volumes of water from its trunk. It weighs as much as a real elephant so it can crush things it's dropped on too. Scales with your energy levels.

Name: Darkbeast Paarl
Short Description: A massive, malformed, lightning wreathed, skeletal beast raised from the dead. It can demolish walls, ignore all conventional bullets, and generate and release electricity at will.

Name: Royal Sentinels
Short Description: Gigantic elite guards that once served Anor Londo. They're several times bigger than humans, immensely strong, and are akin to unbreakable walls in terms of durability. They can also heal themselves. Start with 2.

Name: Cloranthy Ring
Short Description: A ring with a flower decoration. Increases stamina regeneration and recovery after exhaustion.

Name: Blue Stoneplate Ring
Short Description: A gold ring with an icy blue rectangular gem. Boosts defense against ice and cold

Name: Golden Apple
Short Description: A magic apple with a skin made of gold. Eating it grants enhanced regeneration for one hour, and increased ability to survive attacks

Name: Levitation Necklace
Short Description: A necklace with a little pendant shaped like a pair of wings. Allows you to fly at 10 km/h in any direction, mostly horizontally with some elevation capability.

Name: Cloak of Invisibility
Short Description: One of the Deathly Hallows, allows for invisibility, immunity to clairvoyance, and could let you hide from Death itself if you wanted. Provided you're not murdered.

Name: Second Face
Short Description: A white full face mask that, when worn, makes you look like someone else, allowing you to make exactly one second identity.

Name: Nymph Waterfall
Short Description: A waterfall populated by lesser Nymph. The waterfall itself spawns more Nymphs regularly, all of which will follow your orders. Waterfall can be summoned and desummoned at will.

Name: Sahara Slicers
Short Description: A pair of arid daggers that allows you to spawn and launch 10 arid shivs every 30 seconds in a deadly barrage.

Name: Pip-Boy 3000
Short Description: The most iconic wrist-mounted piece of technology from Vault-Tec, allows you to monitor your health and inventory, connect to radio and info networks, map areas, shine a light in dark spaces, etc.

Name: Soul Solid
Short Description: A cane sword belonging to Brook of the Straw Hat Pirates. Extremely sharp, does not dull. Very fashionable. Carries just the slightest imprint of its past user's skill.

Name: Chikage
Short Description: The blade wielded by Annalise, Queen of the Vilebloods. Its runes allow you to sink the blade into your own flesh and sacrifice blood and vitality to amplify its strength. Amplifies necromantic and blood-based abilities.

Name: Deed to Land
Short Description: A deed that, when ripped, gives you legal ownership of a plot of land of your choice, in any currently purchaseable size.

Name: Erza Scarlet Fumo
Short Description: A fumo of Erza Scarlet. Shake it violently to instantly change your clothes to any other set you own at will, swapping their locations.

Name: Vordt's Great Hammer
Short Description: A hammer made of titanite previously wielded by Vordt of the Boreal Valley. Extremely heavy. Extremely deadly. Imbued with frost, capable of freezing enemies it strikes. Enhances ice based abilities.

Name: Phone a Friend
Short Description: A single use landline phone. Call anyone you're thinking of in the universe you're in and speak with them for an hour before the phone disappears entirely.

Name: Silver Bag of Holding
Short Description: A hip bag woven from silver thread, able to contain three thousand pounds worth of items. You automatically know how to find anything inside.

Name: Apprentice Acting
Short Description: You're a skilled enough actor to get hired in an actual movie, or enough to fool most non-detectives or familiar people

Name: Karate
Short Description: You're good enough to be a blue or red belt at actual karate, knowing kata, training techniques, strikes and kicks, you might even learn how to harness your internal energy for stronger attacks.

Name: Wilderness Survival
Short Description: You're great at wilderness survival- you can build shelters, find food and water, track animals, secure belongings, orient your direction, so on and so forth.

Name: Beginner Leadership
Short Description: You can motivate people decently enough, but like... at a school group project level. No one will follow you to hell, but they'll do what they tell you to as long as it makes sense.

Name: Apprentice Stealth
Short Description: You're now stealthy enough to be a generic ninja grunt- set traps, sneak up on people, gather information, move silently, so on and so forth.

Name: Begging
Short Description: You're damn good at throwing all your dignity away to get what you want. People are more receptive to your begging and will actually accept your requests on a regular basis.

Name: Apprentice Fine Arts
Short Description: You're an accomplished artist in drawing, painting, sketching, sculpting, etc. You could definitely get a high paying job as an artist with a patron, but you're not era defining.

Name: Beginner Total Concentration Breathing
Short Description: You now know enough about Total Concentration Breathing to increase blood oxygen and activate your muscles as long as you maintain that breathing cycle. You're not very good at it yet, though...

Name: Sunshine Charm
Short Description: You've got the vibe of a great, kind, innocent person. It's way easier to convince someone that you're a good person now.

Name: Badboy/Badgirl Charm
Short Description: You've got the vibe of a cool, edgy, delinquent kinda person. It's way easier to convince someone that you're cool and brooding. Emos love you.

Name: Magpie's Eye
Short Description: You're very good at spotting treasure and valuables to the point that anything valuable in line of sight gets highlighted for you.

Name: Natural Scent
Short Description: Upgrade to Perfumer. You never have to worry about smelling bad ever again. Your scent and sweat smell like fine perfume- not too much, always pleasant to whoever smells you.

Name: Iron Man
Short Description: No, not the cool one. You're just really resilient to horrible conditions- sleeping in stressful situations, enduring stress and strain, pushing through wounds and exhaustion. So on and so forth.

Name: Strong Legs
Short Description: Your legs are stronger and tougher now, enhancing speed and kicking strength by a significant degree

Name: Goth Magnet
Short Description: You naturally attract alt, goth, emo, punk, and edgy people. Most people will also excuse your less social actions as just being an edgelord or plain weird.

Name: Pacifism
Short Description: Toggle your ability to kill. When on, no matter how hard you hit someone, no matter how much damage you do, your target or victim will survive. Not always whole or recoverable, though.

Name: Enhanced Vitality
Short Description: Enhance your health and vitality, increasing your healing speed and making you healthier overall.

Name: Scavenger
Short Description: You have a higher chance of finding something useful or valuable when scavenging around any given area.

Name: Student
Short Description: You're now much better at learning things, being a student, and taking information from people with more experience than you at any given subject.

Name: Renown
Short Description: News of your exploits and accomplishments always reaches somewhere ahead of you, increasing your reputation slightly. Your reputation is always well known in populated areas.

Name: Restful
Short Description: Your energy and health recover faster when sleeping

Name: Arthropod Affiliate
Short Description: You are a friend to all arthropods- insects, arachnids, crustaceans, isopods, etc. Also increases the strength and efficiency of your physical durability and armoring abilities

Name: Health Insurance
Short Description: Every time you're injured, you gain the exact amount of money you'd need to get it treated at the nearest medical professional. No, you are not allowed to commit insurance fraud with this one.

Name: Enhanced Lungs
Short Description: Your lungs are stronger, tougher, and more flexible. You can process oxygen faster and better, giving you more energy to work with.

Name: Flame Blast
Short Description: Unleash a concentrated beam of flame from your hands. You can dial the power up or down by spending more or less energy. Not really a kamehameha, but it sure looks cool.

Name: Flame Hose
Short Description: Unleash a constant stream of flame from anywhere on your body. The more energy spent, the hotter the flame gets and the further it goes.

Name: Mist
Short Description: Create and control mist within 100 meters, allowing you to obscure vision, hinder movement, smother flames, even generate icy mist to freeze surfaces or enemies, or create solid mist to attack after enough practice.

Name: Whirlpool
Short Description: Create and control whirlpools of water, using them as barriers, projectiles, traps, nuisances, or party tricks even.

Name: Ice Spike
Short Description: Create and launch ice spikes like bullets, or have them impale up from surfaces within 20 meters. The more energy you spend, the stronger and bigger they get.

Name: Air Whips
Short Description: Create and control compressed air whips capable of lashing, grabbing, or slicing with enough speed. More energy expended creates longer and stronger whips.

Name: Move Earth
Short Description: Telekinetically move the earth around within sensory range, though it doesn't have much lethal power beyond making pitfalls.

Name: Invisibility
Short Description: Turn yourself invisible by bending light around you and anything you're touching.

Name: Natural Weapons
Short Description: Every single attached part of your body can be strengthened and sharpened into a natural weapon- fangs, claws, spines, quills, spikes, etc etc.

Name: Poison Breath
Short Description: Breathe out a cloud of lethally toxic gas that also corrodes solid matter with its potency

Name: Emergency Exit
Short Description: When lethally injured, automatically teleport to the nearest safe area within a 1km radius. 30 minute cooldown.

Name: Third Person
Short Description: Toggle on your third person camera to see the world like you're playing an RPG. Allows corner peeking too.

Name: Toggle
Short Description: Turn objects within 100 meters on and off. Does not work on anything living. Works great on electronics and abilities.

Name: Lesser Physical Enhancement
Short Description: Augment your physical abilities by expending energy, boosts strength, agility, durability, etc. Scales with your own base stats and energy expenditure. Not very substantial.

Name: Building Transmutation
Short Description: Transmute matter on a macro scale. No complex constructs or anything smaller than a shed, but you could turn flat ground into an apartment complex in an hour. Not a combat power.

Name: Disillusioned
Short Description: See through any kind of physical deception that is not magic based- sleight of hand, pitfalls, disguises, mirages, one way mirrors, etc.

Name: Point of View
Short Description: Adjust your viewpoint from first person, to second person (using a targeted person), to third person at will.

Name: Blood Golem
Short Description: Shed blood to create blood golems from the puddle on the ground. Strength and number depend on physical stats as well as blood shed. Minimum requirement of 100ml

Name: Cor Leonis
Short Description: Sense allies as spots of light in your vision, allowing you to transfer their physical and mental conditions to yourself, or transfer them between willing allies.

Name: Mind Blast
Short Description: Send a wave of psionic energy through your eyes to cause mental damage to any target hit, confusing them and causing headaches. Efficacy depends on mental resilience and magical power of the target.

Name: Sightlines
Short Description: When activated, anyone who can see you visually is highlighted in red, with a line connecting their field of vision to the part of you they can see.

Name: Tech Tree: Industrial Mecha
Short Description: You can create, modify, and design anything related to slow, clunky, large mecha capable of construction work, industrial lifting, or slow combat with existing armor and guns.

Name: Charizard
Short Description: A roughly six foot tall winged firebreathing lizard. Ornery and quick to anger, but also powerful and fast and extremely loyal. Female, and lays eggs every now and then.

Name: Slime
Short Description: The generic blue RPG slime, a blue blob immune to physical strikes, capable of spitting acid globs and corroding items with its body fluids. Grows stronger by eating organic stuff, and evolve when fed powerful magical foods

Name: King Nothing
Short Description: A Stand made of jigsaw puzzle pieces, capable of tracking any person or object via scent when exposed to a pertinent object. Will automatically pursue until the target is found. Can also disassemble itself at will and use its pieces to mock up shapes and locations.

Name: Nick Valentine
Short Description: Owner of the Valentine Detective Agency, a synth specializing in information gathering and detective work. He's good at hacking, ranged and melee combat, and investigations. A bit of an old model synth, though.

Name: Enough Gun
Short Description: More bullets always works. So long as you are using it or directly in charge of the people using it, guns and other completely mundane weaponry will work on anything. It doesn't matter if they're a god, an eldritch entity, or have some sort of crazy power- put enough bullets into them and they'll die. Though you have to have enough bullets first...

Name: Flynn Taggart's Arsenal
Short Description: A pocket dimension full of the armor and armaments used by Corporal Flynn Taggart, aka the Doom Slayer. None but you may enter. Also comes with a voice activated guide and user manual for everything in the warehouse. All weapons are upgradeable. Unmaykr, BFG 9000, Crucible Sword, and Sentinel Hammer ammo takes 1 week to restock. Everything else takes 24 hours.

Name: Rei-quarium
Short Description: A large glass tank containing several dozen soulless clone bodies of Rei Ayanami. They can be decanted, but will swiftly degrade and dissolve into LCL if removed while lacking a soul. Try not to look at it too often.

Name: Geneforged
Short Description: You evolve to become magically and physically perfect, allowing you to create life and cast magic more easily. You start with fire magic, a single fire breathing raptor summon, and the ability to grow via conflict and time. You become more alien the more you evolve, though this can be mitigated with the right evolutions.

Name: Beginner Shaper Knowledge
Short Description: You have the skills of an introductory Shaper, including the ability to manufacture Life utilizing Essence. You start out knowing what tools you need, the initial Shaper infrastructure creations, and the knowledge of how to improve as a shaper. Improves your magic slightly.

Name: Fully Stocked RV
Short Description: A fully stocked and fueled RV filled with enough food and water to last a single person a week. The RV's gas tank and fridge refills automatically after a week.

Name: Way of the Pistol Shrimp
Short Description: Create cavitation bubbles in any material by snapping your fingers, clapping, or otherwise striking something very hard. The surroundings will quickly collapse around the bubble again, and cause a plasma flash from the impact.

Name: Yarn of Minos
Short Description: A large bundle of red yarn. When this yarn is laid down, it cannot be removed unless reeled/raveled back into its spool. Perfect for finding your way out of mazes or to prevent from getting lost.

Name: Reverse Possession
Short Description: If something tries to possess you, you can instead trap it inside you and force it to help you against its will. You gain a small portion of the would be possessor's powers and can gain even more of theirs depending on what deals you make in exchange with them.

Name: Techadon Gauntlet
Short Description: A large disembodied armored gauntlet that is capable of shooting lasers that can puncture through concrete from the palm or fingers. If worn the gauntlet will begin to rebuild the rest of its body back into a techadon robot  around your body within a couple of days.

Name: Kamikaze
Short Description: At the time of your death, your body self destructs with all the energy you have gained up to that point. If you are out of energy, treat the explosion as if you had a full tank

Name: Mann vs Machine
Short Description: Nine robotic replicates of the mercenaries from Team fortress 2. They only have their default/stock loadouts of the classes they are made up of. Restocks upon destruction. Any upgrades applied to the robots stay upon being restocked.

Name: Giant Jumping Sandman Scout
Short Description: A large robotic duplicate of the Scout from Team Fortress 2. It is rather fragile compared to what its size may suggest, but is also incredibility fast and mobile. Bats baseballs with the force of a cannon, at the rate of pistol fire. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Sergeant Crits
Short Description: A giant, self repairing, robotic duplicate of the Soldier from Team Fortress 2. It is an incredibly resilient and durable robot with a rocket launcher capable of shooting out crit-boosted rockets at the same rate of a machine gun. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Giant Flare Pyro
Short Description: A large robotic duplicate of the Pyro from Team Fortress 2. It uses an equally giant Flare gun that is incredibly accurate and fast firing with quick reloading time. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Sir Nukesalot
Short Description: This mechanical monster is a Giant Demoman wielding a cannon that shoots out large grenades that have the same smoking effect as the Sentry Buster's explosion. It is incredibly durable and has great destructive potential. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Captain Punch
Short Description: A humgonus robotic duplicate of Heavy from Team Fortress 2, armed only with Fists of Steel. Has incredible resistance against all long range attacks and is overall incredibly durable compared to other robots. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Mass Teleporting Engineer
Short Description: An incredibly durable robotic duplicate of the engineer. Has most of the intelligence and blueprints of the Engineer's design. Capable of quickly setting up sentry nest and large teleport that can teleport dozens of units. Requires t00 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Mini Sentry-chan
Short Description: A mini sentry made into a sort of childish humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Rather quiet and deadpan. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Mimi the Mini Sentry Turret
Short Description: A mini sentry made into a vaguely teenage humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. A prankster and vicious little gremlin. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Senthia the Sentry Turret
Short Description: A sentry turret made into a very dangerous humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Vivacious and vicious in equal measures. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Dis-Penelope the Dispenser
Short Description: A dispenser made into a motherly humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Very motherly, but still a prankster. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Entela and Exodus the Teleporter Twins
Short Description: A teleporter set made into a pair of humanoid twins. Carries the same capabilities as the normal buildings, but far more deadly due to being sapient, mobile robots. Both of them are fun loving gremlins. Don't really talk, but they make expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants pair in another team color.

Name: Telle Twins (#1 and #2)
Short Description: A teleporter set made into a pair of humanoid twins. Carries the same capabilities as the normal buildings, but far more deadly due to being sapient, mobile robots. Both of them are cutesy gremlin types. Don't really talk, but they make expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants pair in another team color.

Name: Noelle the Repair Node
Short Description: A repair node made into a cutesy, young adult humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Cutesy, but also incredibly vicious. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Ambie the Ambassador
Short Description: An Ambassador revolver made into a mature, refined humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal weapon, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Rather quiet and smug. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Sapphyre the Electro Sapper
Short Description: A sapper made into a tiny gremlin form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. A very cat-like gremlin. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Sasha the Minigun
Short Description: A minigun made into a one-armed, very sturdy humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Rather quiet and deadpan. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Matilda the Tank
Short Description: A bomb tank made into a gigantic, burly humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Quiet, but extremely deadly. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults BLU, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

Name: Aperture Science Turret-chan
Short Description: An Aperture Science turret made into a cute humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Has an innocent, cutesy personality. Every duplicate of this ticket grants another turret, but you can build more on your own if you want.

Name: Combine Turret-chan
Short Description: A Combine turret made into a cute humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Has an aggressive, militaristic personality. Every duplicate of this ticket grants another turret, but you can build more on your own if you want.

Name: Scrap Turret Girl
Short Description: A machine gun turret made into a cute, skeletal, usually one-armed humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Has an aggressive, sadistic personality. Every duplicate of this ticket grants another turret, but you can build more on your own if you want.

Name: Femet Berry
Short Description: A berry that, in exchange for lowering EVs, sharply raises the estrogen levels in any given pokemon, turning them more voluptuous and feminizing them into something more sexually agreeable. Start with 30 berries. No more than one a day, unless you want things to get VERY interesting.

Name: A-series Anthroball
Short Description: A pokeball that turns any pokemon caught within into a voluptuous, horny, sexually available anthropomorphic version of that species, turning males into estrogenized femboys, and females into breeders. You get 6 on a standard pokeball belt.

Name: B-series Anthroball
Short Description: A pokeball that turns any pokemon caught within into a voluptuous, horny, sexually aggressive anthropomorphic version of that species, turning males into musclebound fuckmonsters, and females into... musclebound fuckmonsters, also with included giant penis. You get 6 on a standard pokeball belt.

Name: "Rare" Candy
Short Description: It works the exact same as a normal rare candy, but the extra hormones within estrogenize the human body and have an aphrodisiac, psychoactive, and feminizing aspect to the point that taking too many will almost entirely feminize any male or female into a mindbroken fuckpet, including the ability to get pregnant even without a vagina.

Name: Joy
Short Description: Seraphim of the First Sphere, shapeless and spiritual, they take female form when in the mortal plane, and can even duplicate themselves if they wish. Yes, the stripper dancing before battle is normal.

Name: Umbra Witch
Short Description: You are an Umbra Witch, a practitioner of the Dark Arts, overseer of history. Your hair itself is a conduit for your magic, and your magic comes from the defeat and contracting of demons to serve your will. Also, you're a girl now, retroactively. Although this ticket starts with high stats, you don't get access to any of it until you start subjugating demons to your will. You start with an Umbran Watch and knowledge of Bullet Arts.

Name: Lumen Sage
Short Description: You are a Lumen Sage, a practitioner of the holy arts, overseer of history. Your robes are a conduit for your magic, and your magic comes from prayer and the beseeching of angels to grant you power. Also, you're a guy now, retroactively. Although this ticket starts with high stats, you don't get access to any of it until you start contracting angels for more strength. You start with a Lumen's Watch and Divine Robes.

Name: Rapid Fire Bowman Sniper
Short Description: A giant robotic duplicate of Sniper from Team Fortress 2. Is immuned to being stunned and fires large arrows, with an even larger wonky hitbox, at the rate of a machine gun. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Giant Medic Robot
Short Description: A large robotic duplicate of the Medic from Team Fortress 2. Its medigun can repair both man and machine, but lacks the original's ambition. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

Name: Boeing 737 Commercial Airliner
Short Description: A functioning commercial airliner that is completely out of fuel. Can only be summoned at ground level, and once summoned is stuck until refueled

Name: Infinite Ammo AK-47
Short Description: A Ak-47 that has infinite ammo. The magazine can not be removed nor can attachments be added. This gun cannot break under its own power

Name: Teleporter
Short Description: A device with 3 green buttons and one red one. Has a 1 in 6 chance of actually working properly, and a cooldown period of 24 hours. If it doesn't work as intended, will teleport the user to a random location without their safety in mind.

Name: Sorcerer's Weekly Magazine
Short Description: Grants the user access to the Spook Fortress Spells but only in October or the equivalent month. Can be improved to working all year round, if rolled again.

Name: Tattoos of Vengeance
Short Description: Congrats on your new tattoo! Each time you avenge a wrong done to you or your family (or close friends), the tattoo gets bigger and increases your physical abilities.

Name: Drukhari Wych
Short Description: A Dark Eldar specialized in ritual duel. She seeks to maximize the suffering of her foe and act as sensually as possible while doing so. Her lack of clothes and protection is both to incite desire and frustration by showing she doesn't need any protection to take a foe down. They are actively evil and will attempt to corrupt their master with promises of pleasures and delicacies, or as thanks from freeing their soul from being eaten by demons.

Name: Orowyrm
Short Description: A massive robotic beast of gold and ivory, a symbol of power from an empire long since destroyed. A monstrous creature capable of breathing deadly flame, has the strength to destroy castles and dig through solid stone. Kinda looks like a worm on a string.

Name: Tech Tree: NERV
Short Description: You can create, modify, and design anything remotely related to NERV or its offshoot WILLE's technology. This includes Evangelions, Reiquariums, plugsuits, the Lance of Longinus, Angel/Eva hybrids, etc etc. Comes with a free AT Field, albeit it starts extremely weak and barely able to block a 9mm bullet. Starts with a chunk of Lilith DNA just big enough to clone repeatedly for raw material.

Name: Exodia the Forbidden One
Short Description: An extremely powerful entity bound in cards. All five of which are now yours. It takes effort and will to draw a card, but should you manage to get all five in a single fight (you always start with zero) Exodia will manifest and instantly end it. Or at least serve as an effective combatant in the extremely rare case you're fighting something that can actually stand against him.

Name: Civilight Eterna
Short Description: Hail, King of Sarkaz. A floating crown of black crystal, the Civilight Eterna marks one as King of Sarkaz, and inheritor to the memories and emotions of the entire species. In exchange for bearing this, you are granted immense power- capable of casting prophecies over entire bloodlines, manipulating emotions, and seeing the memories of others. Further, you may establish the Sarkaz in the world- simply allow one to pledge to the crown and stab themselves on it and they will find themselves as one of your people. This comes with increased physical abilities and special magical abilities, depending on the bloodline they get.

Name: Quincy
Short Description: You are now a Quincy, a Spiritually Aware human that can manipulate Reishi, and use it as a weapon. This weapon is particularly effective against Spiritual existences. You also can use techniques such as Blut, a defensive tool, and Hirenkyaku, an advanced movement technique. There are other techiques a Quincy can have, but you'll need to learn them.

Name: Schrift
Short Description: A Quincy that holds a Schrift has been granted a letter of the alphabet, A-Z. These letters all correlate to a unique ability for a single Quincy to use. (You probably want to put all the letters in a spinner or something.)

Name: Vollstandig
Short Description: An evolved Quincy Technique, this replaces the previous Letzt Stil, removing the drawback of a complete removal of a Quincy's power, and allowing them to directly manipulate the Reishi in an area at a much higher level. You also get a decent amount of Drip with the transformation, but it can't save someone with no fashion sense.

Name: G-Mod Tool Gun
Short Description: The manipulator gun from Garry's Mod. Allows you to manipulate, change, and modify anything shot, or fling them into orbit with the push tool. Or any other usecase you can think of with this ridiculous thing.

Name: Unawoken Whispered
Short Description: Your subconscious mind is connected to a reservoir of hyper advanced scientific knowledge, gaining intuitive knowledge of math, science, technology, engineering, and one specialization that you can choose. Awaken your powers with training to unlock the ability to communicate with other Whispered via telepathy. Try not to do it for too long, though.

Name: Belmont Bloodline
Short Description: You are a descendant of the legendary vampire killers, the Belmont clan. You have increased aptitude with holy weapons and artifacts, and have an easier time facing and combating the undead and unholy, especially vampires. You are naturally talented with using whips and can jump better as well.

Name: Sei Martial Artist
Short Description: You are a calm individual, and therefore you have the ability to utilize Sei Ki. This Ki specializes in predictive and understanding based fighting, with an emphasis on remaining calm being important for the art.

Name: Vampire Killer
Short Description: The legendary whip used by the Belmont clan to slay Dracula. Repeatedly. It usually only allows members of the Belmont bloodline to wield it, but will tolerate you. A holy weapon created by voluntary sacrifice, this weapon will inflict deadly injuries on the undead and unholy, dealing increased damage to vampires and those of Dracula's bloodline.

Name: Dou Ki Martial Artist
Short Description: You are a Martial Artist of the Dou persuasion. You specialize in using your passions to enhance your strikes and endure longer in a fight. Explosive power, the more heated you get, the stronger you are.

Name: Fire Flower
Short Description: A red, yellow, and white flower with black eye like spots in the middle. Can be used to shoot small fireballs from your hands. Taking a hard blow will dispel the effect.

Name: Maker Hands
Short Description: You are a preeminent artist, capable of giving life to anything you shape with your hands, including giving purpose and meaning. You can also use this ability to destroy so long as you can get your hands on the thing in question, so long as it can be used for artistry

Name: Ice Flower
Short Description: A blue and white flower with black eye like spots in the middle. Can be used to shoot small balls of freezing ice from your hands. Taking a hard blow will dispel the effect.

Name: Tech Tree: Abiotic Factor
Short Description: You gain the knowledge of how to create, modify, and design any technology produced by GATE- Garrick Advanced Technology Enterprises, a company that specializes in exploring, studying, and safeguarding various entities, and unusual, often hazardous phenomena.

Name: Mage's Grimoire
Short Description: A leather bound book that contains all the various spells that you know. Also increases magic capacity and potential output by a exponential factor of five while within 5 feet of the holder.

Name: Empty Energeon Cube
Short Description: A 1 cubic meter empty block made of some kind of transparent material. When attached to an energy source, or fuel is poured into it, converts said fuel into a universal energy. A full cube can safely contain a year's worth of power made by a nuclear power plant.

Name: Absurd Strength
Short Description: Your physical strength is rooted and powered by its absurdity in use. The more ridiculous the use in strength the more likely it will occur, such as playing whack-a-mole to create a pitfall, making a splash of water to cause tidal waves, or bending steel girders into origami shapes. Etc.

Name: Finger Pistol
Short Description: By making your hand into a gun shape you make it work like a functioning gun that shoots invisible bullets. When pointing one finger you shoot like a semi-automatic 9mm pistol, by pointing out two fingers you shoot like a magnum revolver.

Name: Mime
Short Description: By miming an object, you bring it to invisible existence. The object or structures have to be considered mundane other than being invisible. If you speak, the mimed object disappears.

Name: Used Hair Salon Products
Short Description: A large box filled with half used hair care products.

Name: Scotty the T. Rex
Short Description: A living copy of the largest known T. Rex. Roughly 13 meters long, 4 meters tall at the hips, and weighing nearly 20,000 pounds.

Name: Big John the Triceratops
Short Description: The largest known triceratops. Big John is 3 meters tall and 8 meters long, and weighs over 13,000 pounds.

Name: Utahraptor Pack
Short Description: A group of 5 utahraptors. 3 male and two female. They are able to breed to make more raptors.

Name: Familiar Reincarnation
Short Description: When/if you die, your consciousnesses is instead transferred to your highest ranking familiar. You lose all of your previously gotten passives, races changes, skills, and abilities but keep your familiars, items, and unused tickets. You keep the Omni Gacha system but lose most of everything else.

Name: Bullet Pattern
Short Description: By expending energy, you can project a solid hologram into a pattern of projectiles ("bullets") or an entity that attacks autonomously (with more bullets). These attacks will do less damage the more unavoidable they are. The higher your energy pool or wider your pool of energy sources, the more dangerous this ability becomes.

Name: Wardrobe of Holding
Short Description: A ticket that summons a large wardrobe with enough mundane clothing in it to last you a whole year. Nothing considered armor and nothing magical, but lots of daily outfits that suit your tastes.

Name: The Merchant
Short Description: "What are ya buying Stranger?'" A blue hooded man with easy access to tons of weaponry and ammunition of all types. Will offer wares but only if they are properly bought off of him.

Name: Full Cache + Charms
Short Description: A metallic black attache case that makes it easier for you to find tinkering supplies. Stocked full with the best weapons of every type from Resident Evil 4. Attached to the case are 3 random charms that give assorted benefits based on the ones chosen.

Name: Mobias Command Center
Short Description: An extremely large mobile base and garage, with cloaking and high powered missiles for defense. Using nano technology, it is capable of reformatting any vehicle into a super version using the templates of Scout, Leader, Special Operations Officer, Artillery, and Technological and Tactics Support using sentient Battle Chips. Contains 5 Battle Chips to start, you'll have to figure out how to get more.

Name: Cartoon Heart
Short Description: Turns your heart into a functioning cartoon heart. Your heart does not need to be attached to any arteries and even when removed from your body, will pump blood through your body like it wasn't.

Name: Marine Battle Ship
Short Description: A single 60 meter long battleship meant to comfortable carry a contingent of 800 marines, fully stocked with uniforms, armaments, kitchenware and supplies for said 800 marines.  The ship has paddlewheels and a Seastone-coated bottom. The ship can only be summoned in a sufficiently large enough body of water. Does not come with a crew complement.

Name: Inferno Blizzard Vision
Short Description: Your right eye fires a cold beam that drains kinetic and thermal energy from objects that it hits. Your left eye burns things with the energy stored from the cold beam. Drains 10 degrees F per second from anything targeted. Heat storage is capped at 50,000 degrees F

Name: Transmodulator
Short Description: A bulky vest and helmet that fires red energy beams from its twin horns. When targeting a living animal, it can mutate them into massive battle forms that you gain innate control over. When fired at dead animals, it resurrects them (mostly) and also allows you to control the reanimated corpse. The two functions are separate, and you must turn the dial on the chest harness to swap between mutation and resurrection modes.

Name: Nanite Canister
Short Description: A canister of active EVO Nanites capable of self reproduction when introduced to a living organic being, insuring they never run out of nanites. High stress or excessive amounts of nanites will cause massive mutations, colloquially referred to as "going EVO", sometimes resulting in kaiju-like forms, sometimes granting wild superpowers. Sometimes both. It's a coin toss if you retain your sanity or not.

Name: Grimoire
Short Description: The diary of Albrecht Entrati, an ornate book of arcane secrets and Void-borne devilry. The pages within this book contain great and vast knowledge of Void energies in such concentration that the secrets themselves become deadly. Deals innate electrical damage in the form of bullet-like energy bolts as a primary fire, or a massive sparking orb with its alternate fire. Can be modified to produce additional effects, with the right tools and conditions.

Name: Goons
Short Description: A whole gang of roughly 30 year old Italian American men who all look vaguely like generic mafia guys, either in suits, blue collar clothes, or overcoats with flat caps. They're not particularly smart, but it's a whole gang of goons to do whatever you need doing, usually grunt work and hits. Start with 50, increasing as your energy pool increases.

Name: Centorea Shianus
Short Description: A prim and proper Centauride with really big boobs. She's honorable, chivalrous, traned in the ways of knighthood, and also very kind and modest. She likes carrots and eats a lot, though she tries to hide the latter. Comes with her full knight's kit and several sets of dailywear, including a bikini.

Name: Appa
Short Description: The presumed last of the Sky Bison, a massive six legged creature with a flat tail, an arrow pattern in his fur, and a gentle, surprisingly intelligent, and a bit snarky personality. Eats lots of hay, grass, fruits, any vegetation he can get his mouth on, really. Can fly and carry roughly six teens and their meager traveling supplies with ease.

Name: Hollow Army
Short Description: An army of emaciated, barely human hollows. They're not very strong, but they know how to use a weapon and beat the shit out of anything you point them at. General armaments include swords, shields, spears, and crossbows (but only one per Hollow). Start with 50, gain more as you become stronger.

Name: Furniture Catalog
Short Description: A standard furniture catalog filled with every form of purchaseable furniture or home decoration within your current world. Upon selecting one to purchase, the manufacturing price of that item will be deducted from your cash or accounts, and the item itself will teleport to you. Cannot be accessed in combat or while in hostile territory.

Name: Red Stoneplate Ring
Short Description: A gold ring with a brilliant red rectangular gem. Boosts defense against flame and heat

Name: Sakuya Izayoi Fumo
Short Description: A fumo of the perfect and elegant maid, Sakuya Izayoi. Any house this fumo is placed in will act as though it is being cleaned and maintained by a whole household's worth of maids 24/7.

Name: Poltergeist's Pillow
Short Description: A pillow that, when slept on, allows your spirit to explore the world at will. Your astral form can pass through solid objects and you are undetectable to most other creatures, though if you don't return within 24 hours you WILL die.

Name: Crimson Behelit
Short Description: A stone that acts as a key to link the Astral World to the Physical World. Usually used to summon the God Hand and facilitate sacrificial ceremonies. The Crimson Behelit allows you to exchange your flesh and blood to become a member of the God Hand and grant you the world... once every 216 years during the Eclipse. Activate this during an eclipse to end the fucking world, you fucking idiot.

Name: Wastelander's Survival Kit
Short Description: A survival kit for a true Courier. Contains Elite Riot Gear, an anti-materiel sniper rifle, a riot shotgun, a .44 Magnum revolver, a bowie knife, 5 repair kits, 10 stim packs, 5 doctor's bags, and 200 ammo for each gun. Also comes with a really snazzy trenchcoat.

Name: 2 Star Heart Ticket
Short Description: Affection in a ticket. Rip it and the person you think about likes you a fair bit more via retcon and causality bending. No side effects but your own guilt.

Name: Repair Powder
Short Description: An enchanted golden powder that repairs weaponry and restores durability as long as the item is in one piece still. The stronger the item, the more powder you need. Some items might need multiple bags of powder to fully repair.

Name: Ring of Suppression
Short Description: A completely nondescript black metal ring that erases your energy signature when worn as long as you do not actively cast abilities or spells or other energy intensive techniques.

Name: Guardian Shield
Short Description: An extremely durable bracelet that becomes a divinely durable round shield when activated. Said shield also works as a bludgeon if you want.

Name: Vial of Everflowing Blood
Short Description: An ornate red vial that produces an endless amount of fresh, healthy, clean O- blood when poured out. Yes, you can use this to feed vampires. Does not carry the essence of any pre-existing person. Might taste like your blood, actually.

Name: One Million Buzzsaws
Short Description: One million buzzsaws stolen from the White Palace. Each 3 meter saw spins perpetually when deployed, and can be returned to item storage if you're careful to not cut yourself doing so.

Name: Clergy Ring
Short Description: A holy ring that gains one spell charge every 8 hours for a maximum of 3 charges at a time. Allows you to cast one of three effects with each charge: Smite - charge your body or weapons with holy light to empower your next strike, Blessing- increase one chosen physical stat for yourself or a target for five minutes, Purify- purify a target of all affliction with strength proportional to your own energy levels.

Name: Ejaculatte
Short Description: A can of very plainly branded coffee. Every swig will cause an orgasm, drinking the whole thing in one go will have you cumming uncontrollably for hours.

Name: Apprentice Hand to Hand Combat
Short Description: You have enough martial arts skill to learn any art at increased speed and put any normal person on the ground in an instant. Pros will still beat you, but it's harder now.

Name: Apprentice Chemistry
Short Description: You know enough chemistry to be a professor, and you can remember most mundane compounds and formula off the top of your head.

Name: Apprentice Massage
Short Description: You're a skilled and experienced masseuse, you can relieve pressure, cause pleasure, untense muscles, and loosen joints with ease.

Name: Kung Fu
Short Description: You're a damn good apprentice in kung fu, knowing all of the basic and some of the intermediate level techniques. You might even be able to use your internal energies to enhance yourself with enough training.

Name: Meditation
Short Description: You are well versed in meditation, clearing and calming and cleansing your mind without distraction. While meditating, energy recovers faster.

Name: Apprentice Discipline
Short Description: You have a remarkable amount of discipline. You can endure discomfort and pain with stoic ease, train when you don't want to, get out of bed when it's really cozy, and maintain focus. You have excellent work ethic.

Name: Litigation
Short Description: You're an experienced lawyer. You have a great grasp of your local world's laws based on nation and locale. You can easily defend yourself or a client in court. You could buy a billboard at this point.

Name: Hacking
Short Description: You are skilled at leveraging your skills to get into networks and get past digital and cybernetic defenses.

Name: Commerce
Short Description: You are very skilled in haggling, buying, selling, figuring out prices, and getting good deals on any transaction you make

Name: Cardboard World
Short Description: You have perfect control over your own strength- if you don't want to break it, you won't break it. Even if you could shatter a planet you could still punch a pillow and not even dent the surface if you desired.

Name: Mountmaster
Short Description: You are a master of riding- any vehicle or mount you take, you can drive, ride, or pilot as if you've been doing it for years and years.

Name: MILF Hunter
Short Description: Married women and MILFs of all kinds are now more attracted to you and consider you a potential romantic interest.

Name: Tough Claws
Short Description: You gain the ability to turn your fingers into exceptionally strong claws capable of cleaving walls, steel, even diamonds in twain. All claw-based abilities and attacks are enhanced threefold.

Name: Avian Ally
Short Description: Birds and all kinds of avian creatures like you a lot more now. You make friends with all avian beings far more easily. Flight effects are now easier to learn and more efficient to use.

Name: Sharp Hearing
Short Description: You have incredibly enhanced hearing, much like an owl. You can distinguish quiet noises, differentiate multiple sound sorces, and adjust your hearing sensitivity on the fly.

Name: Enhanced Strength
Short Description: Your strength is enhanced, adding a threefold multiplier onto your existing strength and allowing you to exert far more force

Name: Charisma
Short Description: Your charisma draws the eye and pulls people in, making you the center of attention in a room and probably everyone's favorite friend if you put in the effort.

Name: Relationship Tracker DLC
Short Description: Your gacha now comes with its own relationship tracker. How the menu displays is up to you, but it allows you to track your relationship with the people around you, and what they think of you. Also logs their likes, dislikes, interests, and relevant information. Does not give you hints on how to romance them. This is a tracker, not a dating sim screen.

Name: Caveman
Short Description: Unga bunga time. You have enhanced physical strength and endurance, plus increased skill in blunt instruments and wilderness survival. Also, you can rock a wild beard and chest hair if you want.

Name: Nothing Strange
Short Description: There is nothing strange about you. Nothing at all. Nobody ever notices anything strange about you, no matter what. Skipping class, talking strangely, going weird places, kissing relatives on the mouth... it's all pretty normal, isn't it?

Name: Lesser Undead
Short Description: Congratulations on rising from the grave! Pick either a zombie or a skeleton to come back as. You have no stamina and consume energy to stay alive and doing stuff. Best figure out how to restock on energy faster than you use it. Cannot be turned off. More of a curse really...

Name: Monstergirl Enthusiast
Short Description: It says girls, but it really means the gender you're attracted to. Monstergirls, beastfolk, hybrids, etc all like you more and find it easier to build relationships with you. More monsters in your world end up compatible with you and your shape and proclivities.

Name: Legal Exemption
Short Description: You're now immune to taxes and rent from any government or local rulers. Also, authority figures and law enforcement will overlook your minor crimes entirely.

Name: Lucky Romantic
Short Description: You just have better luck with your romantic life. That's about it. Go get 'em tiger.

Name: Oedipus Simple
Short Description: Sweet Home Alabama~ You find it easier to fall in love with your family and vice versa. Society at large doesn't much care if you do it either. You and your kin are now immune to inbreeding, and conceived children will now inherit your race changes and passives more easily and are guaranteed to inherit at least two abilities on birth. (You can reroll this for free if it's not your kink)

Name: Hagmaxxing
Short Description: We love older women in this house. Your preferred partners that are significantly older than you (and are at least 40 years old) are more attracted to you and it's easier to earn their favor. You and your partners's looks will not degrade with age, though this doesn't remove the physical effects of aging.

Name: Burner
Short Description: Gain extra resistance to heat and fire based attacks. All fire and heat based abilities, spells, and attacks are more efficient.

Name: Mice Mate
Short Description: You are a friend to all of mouse and rat-kind. Lesser and mundane rodents will automatically be friendly, and might do stuff for you- clean floors, bring shiny things, so on and so forth.

Name: Bully
Short Description: If you're significantly more powerful than your opponent, you get buffs to your physical stats and energy efficiency. Jerk.

Name: Flaming Fists
Short Description: Coat your fists in flame to enhance the power of your strikes while also burning anything hit by said strikes. You can also launch the flames as a fist shaped fireball that hits three times harder than a normal strike.

Name: Flame Coating
Short Description: Coat any object you hold in your hands with flames. Or yourself, if you want. The flames do not harm the object being coated, but burn anything you strike

Name: Lightning Spear
Short Description: Conjure a spear of deadly lightning and hurl it at high speed (no, it does not actually move at lightning speed). Deals extra damage against dragons

Name: Lighning Claws
Short Description: Create claws of lightning over your hands to rend enemies apart and electrocute them at the same time. Extra effective against robots or gooey beings

Name: Rock Shotgun
Short Description: Fire a burst of small stone pellets with the speed and force of a 12 gauge shotgun

Name: Sandblast
Short Description: Launch a stream of sand capable of boring through metal, flesh, or stone with high pressure and even higher velocity

Name: Stalagmite Burst
Short Description: Form stalagmites out of the ground to impale enemies. You can control their shape as they come out, but they only come from the ground

Name: Crystal Shower
Short Description: Create generic crystals from your energy and fire them at targets. The larger the crystal or stronger the impact, the more energy it costs.

Name: Shadow Ball
Short Description: Create a shadowy orb and launch it as a fast moving projectile. Deals extra damage to spiritual beings and ghosts

Name: Deafness
Short Description: Inflict a curse of deafness on an opponent by touch or ranged hex. Duration of deafness depends on target's magic resistance. If magic resistance is minimal, the curse is permanent.

Name: Lesser Blessing
Short Description: Grant a minor blessing to any target by suffusing them with Holy energy. The blessing buffs a chosen trait for one hour: Vitality, Strength, Resilience, Agility, or Stamina. Only one blessing per target.

Name: Carapace
Short Description: Grow a tough carapace over your body to serve as armor. Toughness and defense scales with physical stats.

Name: Stem Cell Generation
Short Description: Flood your body with pluripotent stem cells to start rebuilding your body and healing wounds at the cost of a whole lot of stamina. If drained of nutrients, the process will harm you instead. You may exchange fluids with others to transfer the cells to them.

Name: Clothes Beam
Short Description: Piccolo's best spell, you can fire a beam or channel energy to dress anyone in the clothing of your choice- also includes weighted training gear, but does not include magically enhanced clothing.

Name: No Friction
Short Description: Remove all friction from the target you're touching. With a high enough energy level, might have really bad results for the target in question. Also works on yourself, if you wanna move really fast.

Name: Sonar
Short Description: Exactly what it sounds like. 200m sonar based on echolocating pings, allowing you to map surroundings in your mind.

Name: Cow Form
Short Description: Transform into a cow or a cow hybrid at will, with all the physical abilities and traits that a cow possesses. Or a bull. Ox. Either or.

Name: Hound Nose
Short Description: Increase your olfactory sense to the point of being able to track week old scents across a city, pick out single targets in a room of a hundred, or tell apart any amount of smells even in a dumpster. Effect increases with energy expended.

Name: Tech Tree: Repair
Short Description: You can design, create, and modify anything whose primary purpose is repairing or maintaining assorted technology. Also gives knowledge on weakspots and repair methods for almost any tech you find. Yes, a basic forge counts as a repair facility. So does a roll of duct tape.

Name: Telepath (Quirk)
Short Description: Send a one way telepathic message to anyone within your sensory range, up to a few dozen at a time.

Name: Tech Tree: Erotics
Short Description: You can design, create, and modify technology and items related to sex and eroticism. Sex toys, aphrodisiacs, baby oil, lotion, lube, contraceptives, fuck machines, sex dolls, sex bots, etc.

Name: Tech Tree: High Tech Vehicles
Short Description: You can design, create, and modify high tech vehicles and their surrounding items and infrastructure. Any car from Cyberpunk 2077, flying motorcycles, trains on hardlight rails, etc etc.

Name: Restraint Levels
Short Description: You can place restraint levels on yourself or targets who are willing/unable to resist. The restraint levels prevent the target from utilizing their full powers, and can even seal away entire abilities and racial traits depending on how many there are. Can be lifted temporarily by speaking the command phrase, or by you releasing the effect entirely

Name: Familiar Manifestation
Short Description: Summon part (ie a limb or any other body part) of any of your familiars to attack. Your familiar does not take damage while being summoned this way.

Name: Necrotic Weaponry
Short Description: Imbue your body or weapons with necrotic energy that leeches health from enemies and amplifies your own attacks. Deals extra damage to living targets. Can be flung as a projectile.

Name: Meal Enhancement
Short Description: Enhance the properties of your own cooking, imbuing nutrients and making the ingredients used more powerful and high quality. The better you cook, the better it tastes and enhances

Name: Thought Acceleration
Short Description: Increase the speed that your brain processes information, allowing you to plan and strategize faster. Can also be used in combat, though overuse can have negative effects.

Name: Bulk Up
Short Description: Reinforce and strengthen your muscles to superhuman level, allowing even a base human to tear apart cars and fling them like nothing. Overuse will cause extreme soreness and muscle tearing.

Name: Crow Claw
Short Description: A Branch of Sin that allows you to spend vitality and turn your blood into sickle-blades across your entire body. The stronger the blades, the more health and blood it takes to maintain.

Name: Rent-a-Tenno
Short Description: Need someone dead? Need something stolen? Need an entire space station crippled and all its occupants turned to ash? Rent a Tenno! Upon activating this throwable and reusable beacon, you may pay any amount of applicable currency and/or esoteric materials and object rewards to hire a Tenno for any job you may need. The more you pay, the more experienced, lethal, powerful, and swift your hired Tenno will be. No, they will not give you any of their stuff. Only useable once every twelve hours.

Name: Yoruichi
Short Description: The Former 22nd Head of the Shihoin Clan, Yoruichi is the former captain of the 2nd Division of the Gotei 13, and former commander of the Onmitsukido. As a Captain Class combatant, she would easily be able to tear through a country with little able to stop her in a Normal World, and her skill is centuries strong. Has a fondness for cats and strawberries.

Name: Tech Tree - Eggtech
Short Description: MUAHAHAHA! LISTEN UP, FOOL! I, DR.ROBOTNIK, THE GREATEST GENIUS IN THE WORLD, HAVE DEEMED THIS PALTRY ROULETTE SYSTEM AN ACCEPTABLE TOOL FOR MY PLANS! FROM NOW ON I SHALL LET YOU GAIN MY MIGHTY INTELLECT AND MECHANICAL WONDERS SO YOU CAN SPREAD THE JOY OF MY EMPIRE! You will begin with the knowledge of my first rodeo against that BLASTED RODENT!

Name: Granberia
Short Description: One of the Four Heavenly Knights, and the second strongest among them. Granberia is a dragon warrior who fights for honour and duty. Prove your strength and valor to earn her respect. Otherwise be ready for a hell of endless training until you satisfy her, either in battle or in the bedroom

Name: Luna
Short Description: Looking like a talking black cat with a crescent moon symbol on her forehead, Luna is actually an alien from the planet Mau. Luna is the able to sense magic and is sensitive to the presence of evil, and can temporarily with great effort assume a human form. She has access to a pocket space and has minor telepathic powers.

Name: Puma Twins
Short Description: Ana and Una Puma are twin catgirl androids, originally created as pleasure droids and strippers, they turned to a joy riding life of crime. They are strong, fast, beautiful, and deadly,  enjoying explosions, fast cars, and making cops look like idiot.

Name: Shiva
Short Description: A beautiful Ice Queen, Shiva is an icy blue spirit with powerful ice magic. She has been summoned by many in the past and is an experienced combatant. Not very social, though.

Name: Strawberry Cow
Short Description: A bright pink cow that produces strawberry milk.

Name: Cheetara
Short Description: A ThunderCat warrior, Cheetara is a speedster with a casual jogging speed of 120 mph. She also has a sixth sense that gives minor pre- and post-cognitive visions and a basic danger sense. She is skilled with a bo staff and carries a collapsible staff in her bracer.

Name: Sword of Omens
Short Description: A nigh unbreakable magic sword that cannot be used for evil, the Sword of Omens gets it's name from the Eye of Omens, a powerful gem that contains a sentient all-seeing force of magical power. The Sword of Omens can be scry with, emit ruby energy blasts, and emit a symbol to summon and empower your allies. Shrinks down to dagger size for easy of transport.

Name: Perfected Nanite Canister
Short Description: A canister of Perfected Nanites. When injected into someone, turns the person biologically immortal at the prime time of their life, making them peak human, as well as letting them rapidly regenerate grievous wounds. (Yes I want this version to be separate from the EVO nanites)

Name: The Ooze
Short Description: A large container containing blue sludge like liquid. When exposed to a creature/person the sludge rapidly mutates and merges the creature/person with last animal, creature, or object they have touched in the past few hours. Mutagen can also be used as a substitute for Fuel. The mutagen refills itself as long as the container isn't broken.

Name: 1 Gnorp
Short Description: One single Gnorp. Alone it is weak but extremely adaptable, and can be put to work to do basically anything; however be aware that it's pretty small. Do note they will require rock fragments (what they call shards) to make things. Also durable enough to slam themselves against rocks for hours without tiring.

Name: Copy Skill/Ability/Passive
Short Description: Allows you to copy a skill, ability, or passive from any of your current familiars while active. If the familiar dies or is otherwise dismissed, the copy immediately fades away.

Name: 5 Gnorps
Short Description: See the 1 Gnorp entry. But instead of just 1 Gnorp, you get a 5 pack of them.

Name: 25 Gnorps
Short Description: See the 1 Gnorp entry. But instead of just 1 Gnorp, you get a 25 pack of them. The more Gnorps there are the stronger they get!

Name: Non-Newtonian Body
Short Description: Your body is practically slime-like. The harder and faster something physical hits you, the less impact and injury it will cause. Does not fully account for slashing or piercing like attacks.

Name: Incremental Weapon
Short Description: A weapon that takes a form of your preference, it starts out as the Weakest possible variation capable of infinite use on the weapon. As you use it, you gain a greater and greater capacity to modify and alter it according to your experiences, and any special resources you encounter. Also grants you Money each time you use it.

Name: Tech Tree: Ecological
Short Description: You are now able to create devices and contraceptions related to restore the place you live in. This can include reforestation devices, depolluting the water, improving the soil... Up to actually recreate ecosystem and resources.

Name: Tech Tree: Biology
Short Description: Ever wanted to create your own affronts to God's creation by creating weird creatures? Or simply because you want to mess with genetics? Congratulations! Though your beginning will be humble, such as understanding how a creature tick, you will improve to being able to modify them with the correct equipments.

Name: Horror Slasher Movement
Short Description: From now on, you gain an increased boost on movement speed dexterity whenever no one is looking at you and if you are pursuing someone, you gain for the duration the ability to phase through objects and what would be the optimal path to catch them from the most unexpected and irrational places.

Name: World of Magic
Short Description: Suddenly, magic awaken. Slowly but surely, magic is coming (back) into the world. Will it heal it or make it worse? That depend on the inhabitants.

Name: Seed of Mana
Short Description: Always wanted your typical world tree, big enough to be visible from the sky? Congratulations, you have your own! Well, rather, its seed. Plant it and care for it. Once it has sprouted, mana will naturally emerge from it and nature will strengthen around it. However, be careful. While it's a powerful tree, it's a tree. Meaning it can get burn, sick etc...

Name: Blair
Short Description: Here come the Cat Witch! While she prefers to walk around in an human form and flirt with everything (the lady is pansexual), she is initially a magical cat and can wield Pumpkin magic aside from her transformation. She is a huge pervert and will tease you with pleasure!

Name: Copy Skill
Short Description: Let's you copy a single Skill from any of your current Familiars as long as Copy is occupying a power slot. If the Familiar is dismissed or killed the copied skill also goes away.

Name: Copy Ability
Short Description: Let's you copy a single ability from any of your current Familiars as long as Copy is occupying a power slot. If the Familiar is dismissed or killed the copied ability also goes away.

Name: Copy Trait
Short Description: Let's you copy a single Trait from any of your current Familiars as long as Copy is occupying a power slot. If the Familiar is dismissed or killed the Trait also goes away.

Name: Tunneling
Short Description: You are able to make a tunnel as tall as you are and freely travel through the ground. The tunnel will not collapse under its own power. You can make a tunnel by simply walking Into the ground. The parts that you dug out will appear five feet away in a mound. This ability improves with your walk or run speed.

Name: Alexandria Package
Short Description: You get super strength, flight, and a sensory like Powers based on similar Gacha rolls. These combo of abilities only cost One Ability Slot.

Name: Bullet Imbuement
Short Description: Any bullet that you manually load in a gun will be imbued with any energy the you has access to.

Name: Solid Grasp
Short Description: You are able to touch the etheral and magical spells with little to no harm of it affecting you while you are holding it. As long as it looks physical enough, you can grab it. Scales with your physical strength.

Name: CyberDemon
Short Description: The Cyberdemon from the Doom 2016 game. If the demon is killed, you can resurrect it by offering the souls of freshly slain sapient beings, or by pumping its corpse with demonic/unholy energy.

Name: Doom Hunter
Short Description: A single Doom Hunter. The amount you can summon increases with every sapient being you kill starting from 100, then 200 more, and so on and so forth. Can be enhanced biologically and/or mechanically if you got the know how.

Name: Elemental Octagon
Short Description: Your next attacks will be coded in the cycle of these elements by consuming energy; Fire, Ice, Earth, Lightning, Poison, Acid, Holy, then Unholy. If your attack doubles up on any of the damage types, the potency and power of that attack increases. Dismissing the ability does not restart the octagon,

Name: Imp Pack
Short Description: Summons a group of 5 basic Imps from Doom. The more powerful you get you more you can summon and the more variety of imps you get.

Name: Full Cooler
Short Description: A small cooler packed with your least favorite foods.
